quests.name: A Spark in the Dark
quests.description:
Maxwell Sterling
Goldenfield, near Wheat tent

Check the pile of wood near the tent.
quests.voice: Go on, fetch the wood. It's right around camp, and you won't have to watch out for wildlife here. This is the safe part... for now.

quests.name: To the Moon, via the Fields
quests.description:
Zoltar Blipchain
Goldenfield, near Wheat tent

Assist Zoltar in curbing the rat infestation in his wheat fields.
quests.voice: Kill those mutated rats in the wheat fields, and bring back some rat tails as proof.

quests.name: Brave New World - Welcome to Kwalat
quests.description:
Zikk Clankwhistle
Dusktide Forest, at the Portal

Speak to the outworlder welcoming specialist. He should be in sight.
Follow the road north to Zikk's house.
quests.voice:
Please speak to the outworlder welcoming specialist. He should be nearby. Don't die, and have a nice day.
Again? The forms are my house to the north, just follow the road. They re on the table outside. I'll give you more instructions once you're close. While you re at it, stop and see Maxwell while traveling north up the road. He'll teach you how to make a campfire, among other things.
Go make an official inquiry to my brother. He s at the Bureau in the center of Goldenfield. Just follow the road north and ask around when you get there.

goals.description: Meet with Zikk's brother in the village

quests.name: Brave New World - Welfare Program
quests.description:
Zugg Clankwhistle
Goldenfield, near the Bureau

Go east across the street to the welfare kitchen.
quests.voice: Head to Martha's welfare kitchen and get yourself a handout. Maybe afterwards, get yourself killed.

quests.name: Brave New World - Baking independence
quests.description:
Martha "Big Mamma" Potterson
Goldenfield, near Welfare kitchen.

Find 3 Wheat Seeds in barrels, crates or around the fields.
quests.voice: Bring me some Wheat Flour. Look around, darling. It's harvest season, and you might find some leftover Wheat in the fields around Goldenfield town or in crates and sacks. You can process 3 handfuls of Wheat seeds into Flour at my Cooking bench.

goals.description: Bring Wheat Flour to Big Mamma

quests.name: Two much colour
quests.description:
Blink-1n
Goldenfield, west of the Welfare kitchen

Surely you understand how to pull weeds...
quests.voice: If someone pulled out the violet weed species, One would be able to prove its usefulness and hence, prolong its existence. The red species must remain untouched. The violet ones must be pulled out.

quests.name: Brave New World - Crafting Proficiency
quests.description:
Martha "Big Mamma" Potterson
Goldenfield, near Welfare kitchen

Help folks around Goldenfield.
quests.voice: Put those hands to use, hot stuff! You need to get better with your fingers, you know? There's plenty a' locals around here who the government pays to teach. Start with Nia Sundance; she's back behind her summer house to the east. She ll help you with some herbal gathering. Then head over to Zogar at the logging spot, which is near Thordal Ironvein to the west of Goldenfield. Chopping down specific trees will be good practice and then you can mine some metals. After that, visit Thordal Ironvein, near Zogar, to mine some metals. It's a bit tougher, but worth it. This order works great for newbies, but feel free to help other locals along the way to pick up new skills. You'll get the hang of it in no time!

quests.name: Vase of the Cracked-tastrophe
quests.description:
Griz Turner
Goldenfield, near Artifact shop.

Gather ceramics and return to Griz.
quests.voice: Don't forget, I need some ceramics to fix those cracks. Look around, I think you'll need Ancient Fossils mined from stone. Outside Goldenfield there are sure to be plenty of rocks for you to check.

quests.name: Vermin Extermination
quests.description:
Hank Granger
Goldenfield, near Tractor.

Find and kill mutated rats around the fields of Goldenfield.
quests.voice: Don't forget, you need to kill 10 rats. They won't disappear on their own. Keep your eyes peeled around the fields. Those rats are sneaky. Look near the barn and the fields. You'll find more than enough of them there.

quests.name: Gnat a problem
quests.description:
Elara Brightfall
Goldenfield, west of the Chicken farm

Find gnats around Elara and to the north of her.
quests.voice: It'd mean everything to me, if you killed these gnats and got the tracking devices back from them.

goals.description: Collect 5 Tracking Devices from gnat bodies
Bring the tracking devices to the student

quests.name: Brews and Blues
quests.description:
Paddy O'Lantern
Goldenfield, near Welfare kitchen

Search barrels, crates and chests for a bottle of whiskey.
quests.voice: Don't forget the whiskey, mate. Could be in a box, could be - hic - in another box. Who knows?

quests.name: Feed the Flock
quests.description:
Granny Hilde
Goldenfield, near Chicken farm

Plant wheat in the holes around the corn fields.
quests.voice: Find those holes my grandson dug up and place those in there to grow. Oh, you re just wonderful.

quests.name: A Taste of Home
quests.description:
Berg Stonefoot
Goldenfield, near Forest Camp

Poultry legs can be harvested from local birds.
quests.voice: Get Salt, and Poultry Legs. Turkey tastes the best, but they're mostly in the forest. However, you might be able to snatch a chicken or a goose from locals if they won't notice.

quests.name: Rat-ical Blockchain Solutions
quests.description:
Zoltar Blipchain
Goldenfield, near Wheat tent.

Pick-up mouse traps from the field, then find some of the rat corpses.
quests.voice: Pick up those traps for me around the field! There s bound to be some rat corpses in em !

quests.name: Percival's Restorative Ointment
quests.description:
Percival "Percy" Beamish
Goldenfield, Alcemy crafting yard

Search for the flasks around the center of Goldenfield. The syringe has got to be around here close.
quests.voice: Remember, I need those flasks. These ingredients are key. They ve got to be hanging around town somewhere!

quests.name: Oil Be Back
quests.description:
Quadro-Sentinel 4.0
Goldenfield, Fields of Goldenfield.

Search crates, chests and barrels around Goldenfield for the spare machine parts.
quests.voice: I must repair my systems. Search barrels, crates, and chests around the fields for spare machine parts. Machine oil is obtained by searching the rubbish dump in Goldenfield.

quests.name: Eggplant Extravaganza
quests.description:
Greta Grubb
Goldenfield, Southern House

Search barrels, crates or satchels on the side of the road full of eggplants.
quests.voice: Could you gather five eggplants for me? They're in the fields nearby. You'll likely find them growing not too far from Goldenfield. Remember, I need five of them so I can start this... baking project.

quests.name: Brew the Beans, Warm the Soul
quests.description:
Nia Sundance
Goldenfield, near Summer house.

Pick up the coffee from the cafe and take it to Maxwell in Dusktide Forest.
quests.voice: Just grab the coffee from Ivie at the cafe and take it down to Maxwell. It bothers me knowing he s probably freezing out there!

goals.description: Pick up the coffee from the cafe

quests.name: Greta's Grudging Gourd Gathering
quests.description:
Greta Grubb
Goldenfield, near Southern house

Search barrels, crates and chests for a mana vial.
quests.voice: Don't forget that Mana Vial, got it? That robot helper of mine ain't gonna fuel itself! You can find them in chests, barrels, or crates. Or if you re feeling handy, you can craft one at the alchemy station!

quests.name: Beggars Can't Be Roasters
quests.description:
Paddy O'Lantern
Goldenfield, Walfare Kitchen

Hunt birds around Goldenfield for an animal carcass.
quests.voice: Remember, lad, we need an animal carcass, onion, -hic-, salt and er, mushroom... red mushroom! That'll cook up a damn fine meal. I don't give a shit what ole Marthy says!

quests.name: Heart of the Woods
quests.description:
Zogar
Goldenfield, near the Fuel station.

Log Faint Timberheart Reserves around Goldenfield and surrounding forests.
quests.voice: Head into the forest and fetch me five pieces of Timberheart Bark. Clean pieces are hard to come by, so take your time.

quests.name: Wisdom within the Rocks
quests.description:
Thordal Ironvein
Goldenfield, near the Fuel station

Mine Soft Crystal Veins around Goldenfield.
quests.voice: Remember, extract Soft Crystal from Soft Crystal Veins and turn it into Powder Filler. And mind the critters.

quests.name: Wisdom within the Woods
quests.description:
Zogar
Goldenfield, near the Fuel station

Log Magic Trees around Goldenfield and surrounding forests.
quests.voice: Gather 3 Tree Roots and craft it into Jewellery Wood on the bench. Simple, right? Off ya go.

quests.name: Wood You Believe It?
quests.description:
Zogar
Goldenfield, Logging spot.

Grab some Calm Aloe from the alchemy area behind the welfare kitchen. An energy drink named ‘Sildenafil’ from a little crossroads just south of here. You’ll see the yellow lights. Lastly a psycho mushroom from the yoga house.
quests.voice: Still no progress? Jahri would be proud. Hustle up, recruit! Or should I just send Jahri a thank-you card? This stuff doesn t pick itself up, you know. It s not like Jahri s going to magically grow a backbone.

quests.name: A Nutty Favor
quests.description:
Nia Sundance
Goldenfield, near Summer house

Search bushes around Goldenfield and surrounding forests.
quests.voice: Remember to process those Hazelnuts into Natural Oil at the crafting table.

quests.name: Brave New World: Hearts and Minds
quests.description:
Martha "Big Mamma" Potterson
Goldenfield, near Welfare kitchen

Martha wants you to put the trade skills you learned to work by helping various people around the village.
quests.voice: People around here might hate you, but they aren't ones to turn down free help. Go ask around any see what you can do for 'em, alright? Nothing sexual though - and trust me, they'll ask.

quests.name: Focus Fuel
quests.description:
Nia Sundance
Goldenfield, near Summer house

Search bushes around Goldenfield and surrounding forests.
quests.voice: Don't forget, those Whisperdew Berries won't just be lying around. You'll need to look for the rare bushes they grow on around Goldenfield.

goals.description: Fill 3 jars up with those berries

quests.name: High Times and Hard Lessons
quests.description:
Jahri Roots
Goldenfield, west of Fuel station

Search bushes around Goldenfield and surrounding forests.
quests.voice: Don't forget the Raspberry Hum Hum, man. I just remembered something about scant weavers. Are dem bushes or nah?

quests.name: Star-Powered Shot
quests.description:
Thordal Ironvei
Goldenfield, Miner's crafting bench

Look for an old tent among rocks and trees about halfway between Gretas and the Faidens Camp.
quests.voice: Don't forget, I need you to find my stash south of town. Look for an old tent among rocks and trees about halfway between Greta s and the Faidens Camp. Keep at it, time's tickin', and Hank's a waitin'!

quests.name: Counterfeit Certificate
quests.description:
Percival "Percy" Beamish
Goldenfield, near the Bureau

Use the recipe to craft some Counterfeit Painkillers.
quests.voice: Remember the Counterfeit Painkillers, dude. My head is counting on you!

quests.name: Rest in Peace
quests.description:
Mortimer Gloomsworth
Goldenfield, near Cemetery

Lifeless bodies are scattered throughout Goldenfield randomly. Keep your eyes peeled.
quests.voice: Rummage around for 10 remains from the lifeless bodies scattered in the forests circling Goldenfield. Those bones, they're the key to some proper burial rites, keeps the dead quiet and satisfied.

quests.name: No pressure
quests.description:
Kicheki
Goldenfield, south east of the Well

Search barrels, crates and chests for copper pipes. Turn off water supply and replace leaking pipes with new ones. Turn it back on after repairing.
quests.voice: Find and replace leakin pipes with new ones. You can usually find 'em in barrels or crates. Oh, and turn off the water supply first! Turn it back on after repair

quests.name: The Scribe's Dilemma
quests.description:
Griz Turner
Goldenfield, near Artifact Shop

Crafting an Uncommon Mana Amulet can take mutliple atttempts.
quests.voice: Bring me an Uncommon Mana Amulet, friend.

quests.name: Cosmic Concoction
quests.description:
D'Rek
Goldenfield, near Workshop

Mine veins in the woods to find the rare adamaybium.
quests.voice: It may take you all day and night, but that Adamaybium is out there! Make haste!

quests.name: Clear Heads and Quick Fixes
quests.description:
Jahri Roots
Goldenfield, west of Fuel station

Craft or trade for an Adrenaline Shot. Percy might have a recipe.
quests.voice: Remember, man, I need that Adrenaline Shot.

quests.name: Eggs for Breakfast
quests.description:
Guru David
Goldenfield, Yoga Lake

Search farms around Goldenfield or butcher birds.
quests.voice: I need 10 fresh eggs for my breakfast! You can find them from local farmers. Visit local farms and gather 10 eggs. The local farms are known for their fresh produce. Be sure to get the eggs without causing a ruckus!

quests.name: Explosive Engineering
quests.description:
Ratchet
Goldenfield, near the Workshop

Use your tradeskills around Goldenfield and the surrounding woods to collect and craft these materials.
quests.voice: Don't forget to craft that Assault Launcher. Remember, you need Leather, Amber, Iron Ingot, and 2 Jewelry Wood.

quests.name: Check Yourself Before You D'Rek Yourself
quests.description:
D'rek
Goldenfield, Construction Craft bench

Search the nearby forests for boars and leaf monsters. Collect the iron rivets from nearby D'Rek.
quests.voice: We need thick hide from a boar and chitin from a leaf monster. Got that? Both should be found easily in the woods.

quests.name: Genetically Gifted
quests.description:
Butch O'Hara
Goldenfield, near Pig farm

Kill boarmammoth in the Skylight Grasslands.
quests.voice: Head up to the Skylight Grasslands. Kill some boars and collect their insides for me. It's tough work, but someone's gotta do it.

quests.name: Herb Your Enthusiasm
quests.description:
Jahri Roots
Goldenfield, west of Fuel station.

Kill wolves in Dusktide Forest to collect their bones
quests.voice: Yo mate, how's the hunt for those wolf bones goin ? I know it must be hard for yuh mon, but I believe.

quests.name: Implant Issues
quests.description:
D'Rek
Goldenfield, near Workshop

It may take a few tries to craft an Uncommon Immuno-Stimulating Implant.
quests.voice: Remember to craft that Immuno-Stimulating Implant. We need to figure out if my original recipe is the issue.

quests.name: A Blooming Melon-drama
quests.description:
Kicheki
Watermelon field

Find Kicheki's guitar around Jahri and search bushes around Goldenfield for a red rose.
quests.voice: Remember, I'm lookin' for my guitar and a red rose! Keep checking those bushes for the finest red rose you can find. And get my guitar back from Jahri  Lord knows what s happened to it.

quests.name: Eggcellent Solution
quests.description:
Berg Stonefoot
Goldenfield, Forest Camp.

Eggs can be found on birds while corn flour is simple enough to grind.
quests.voice: Don't forget, I need corn flour and two eggs. You can craft corn flour, I'm sure Big Momma knows how. Eggs, well, chickens man.

quests.name: Refuel my Fellow Machines
quests.description:
Energizer-21
Goldenfield, near Farmhouse

Search the fields for electrical components, especially around rat camps.
quests.voice: Search the fields for electrical components. Charing station repair is of the utmost importance.

quests.name: Remember the Mystic
quests.description:
Mortimer Gloomsworth
Goldenfield, near Cemetery

Use your tradeskills to craft a Dark horse rune with the blueprint Mortimer gave you.
quests.voice: You will need to gather Powder filler, Jewellery Bone, Jewellery Wood, Composite material, Ceramics and Diamond to craft the Dark horse rune.

goals.description: Bring Dark Horse Rune to Mortimer

quests.name: Repairing the Reaper
quests.description:
Quadro-Sentinel 4.0
Goldenfield, Fields of Goldenfield.

Find gnats in the fields of Goldenfield.
quests.voice: Quadro-Sentinel 4.0 requires 5 gnat skulls as confirmation of extermination. Locate in fields of Goldenfield. Failure to complete mission will result in unauthorized status retention.

quests.name: The Sweet Escape
quests.description:
Ivie Clarkson
Goldenfield, Goldenfield, near the Bureau.

Kill gnats around Goldenfield for their larvae.
quests.voice: Five gnat larvae should be enough to boil up a first batch. This sweetener is going to have them lining up at the cafe. Just you see.

quests.name: A Butcher's Lesson
quests.description:
Butch O'Hara
Goldenfield, near Pig farm

Head to the Skylight Grasslands and Sunweave Glade to find boarmammoths.
quests.voice: Gather Animal Fat and turn it into Cosmetic Fat at the crafting bench. If you have trouble with wolves, try for turtles or boars.

quests.name: Secure the Assets
quests.description:
Oswald
Goldenfield, Bank.

Retrieve Oswald's items then head north to the Skylight Grasslands to find Glubrath.
quests.voice: I'm counting on you to deliver those assets. Dr. Orion Blood and Zorbul have my stuff.

quests.name: Security Measures
quests.description:
Oswald
Goldenfield, Bank

Use the blueprint to craft a Plazma Gun.
quests.voice: Have you managed to find the Plazma Gun Blueprint yet? We can t start without it. I would check with Ratchet, I'm sure he could help.

quests.name: Shell We Eat?
quests.description:
Butch O'Hara
Goldenfield, Barn.

Search for turtles around bodies of water.
quests.voice: Don't forget, three turtle meats. Watch your step out there. The forest can be a real beast. Remember, search around bodies of water.

quests.name: Supply and Command
quests.description:
Ratchet
Goldenfield, Weaponsmithing craft bench.

Search veins outside Goldenfield for all the resources needed.
quests.voice: Still need those materials: a stack of organic hemp, a bundle of heartwood sticks, and a stack of enchanted slate. Just chip away at trees, ore veins, and bushes around Goldenfield and the surrounding woods.

quests.name: The Laid Lover's Locket
quests.description:
Maxwell Sterling
Dusktide Forest, near Tent.

Search dead bodies around the forests for some jewelry.
quests.voice: Just wear some gloves when you're searching those bodies. You got this! Are they stinky? They seem like they'd be stinky... we can always give the jewelry a quick wash.

quests.name: The Burning Hunger
quests.description:
Relkyn Stoutshield
Goldenfield, Faidens camp top centre

Use your cooking tradeskill to cook up some ribs for Relkyn.
quests.voice: Could you bring me some Crispy Fried Ribs? I need them to regain my strength. Look around, you might find some in the nearby camps or markets.

quests.name: Spiritual Cleansing: Rocks and a Hard Place
quests.description:
Guru David
Goldenfield, Yoga Lake.

Search for Leaf Monster camps in the Skylight Grasslands.
quests.voice: Seek out 3 Leaf Monster legs. Delve into the forests of Kwalat, and you might uncover them. Remember, 3 Leaf Monster legs to use for incense sticks; the universe rewards the diligent. Tranquility hinges on those legs. Crack off as many as you can.

quests.name: Spiritual Cleansing: Flowers and Crystals of Persistence
quests.description:
Guru David
Goldenfield, Yoga Lake.

Search the clearings southwest for the Purple Poppy and Yellow Crystal.
quests.voice: Remember, we need a mystical Yellow Crystal and a Purple Poppy. Seek it out in the clearings to the southwest of us. You're sure to find them. Your journey's success relies on your persistence.

quests.name: A Toast to Enlightenment
quests.description:
Cassidy
Goldenfield, Yoga garden rocks.

Head north to the Welfare Kitchen in Goldenfield.
quests.voice: The Lucas Lager, remember? You re gonna have me rebel out here. Just go snag one at the Wellfare kitchen in town. Everyone there will be too drunk to notice. It s not like they ll start a war.

goals.description: Collect the bottle of Lucas Lager out in the Welfare kitchen

quests.name: Spiritual Cleansing: The Fragrant Gel
quests.description:
Guru David
Goldenfield, Yoga Lake.

Find gnats lurking in the fields and collect their wings.
quests.voice: Remember, we need Gnat Wings to complete the ritual. They buzz around in all the lush corners of Goldenfield. Simply look, and be guided to your spiritual destination.

quests.name: A Piece of Zen
quests.description:
Tiffany
Goldenfield, Yoga House.

Search the house south of Nia's shop. Then find an abandoned house southwest of Dr. Bloom in Goldenfield.
quests.voice: Any luck finding my gear? Remember, I'm counting on that treat to complete my journey to zen. Check the house south of Nia's shop for my mat, and the abandoned house southwest of Dr. Bloom. No questions, please.

goals.description: Find the mat in the house Nia
Find the mat in the empty house

quests.name: But Wait, There's Boar!
quests.description: Butch O'Hara Goldenfield, Barn. Hunt Boarmammoths in the woods around Goldenfield and collect their snouts after butchering the beasts.
quests.voice: Venture into the woods surrounding Goldenfield, that s where you'll find your prey. It's not going to be easy. It may be best to group with some of those other lowlives.

quests.name: Mischief Masker
quests.description:
Oswald
Goldenfield, Bank.

Head south to Guru David's and find the masks laying around. Keep your eyes peeled.
quests.voice: Still need those masks from Guru David. Don t forget: Green, Orange Horns, and Pink Bird. Head to the Yoga House in Goldenfield if you ve forgotten where to start. Without those masks, I can't help you with the gear. Keep at it, friend.

quests.name: Venomous Voyage
quests.description:
Grizzle Ironfoot
Westwind Woods, near the Old mine

Search for Fungus camps in the Windreach Woods.
quests.voice: Get your hands on some venom! Those gross-looking fungus creatures are loaded with the stuff.

quests.name: Mission Imp-possible: Ultimate weapon
quests.description:
Ratchet

D'Rek and Griz are both in Goldenfield. You'll find Grizzle Ironfoot south of the sawmill in Westwind Woods.
quests.voice: Remember, you need to help Griz, Grizzle, and D'Rek. Bring all these components back to me so we can build the ultimate weapon!

quests.name: Mission Imp-possible: Off-world Chips
quests.description:
Dr. Orion Bloom 
Goldenfield, Tent near the road.

Search around the lake to the north west by Windstone Village.
quests.voice: Remember, if you bump into an astronaut, give them these coordinates.

quests.name: Mission Imp-possible: Fire Proofed
quests.description:
Butch O'Hara
Goldenfield, near Pig farm

Head to the Windreach Woods to defeat Leaf Creatures.
quests.voice: Remember, it's the Leaf creatures in the Windreach Woods we're after. They won't hunt themselves!

quests.name: Toxic trinkets
quests.description:
Griz Turner
Goldenfield, near Artifact Shop

Help Griz Ironfoot retrieve crucial artifact fragments from the Toxic Waste area in Dusktide Forest.
quests.voice: Find five bottles in the Dusktide Forest's Toxic Waste area. Be cautious of the green, oily liquid. It aint friendly.

goals.description: Collect 5 Blue Bottles and fill in

quests.name: Mission Imp-possible
quests.description:
Martha "Big Mamma" Potterson
Goldenfield, near Welfare kitchen.

Talk to Ratchet, Dr. Bloom, and Butcher about fighting imps.
quests.voice: Talk to Ratchet, Dr. Bloom, and Butcher about fighting imps.

quests.name: Forest's Bounty
quests.description: Hilda Deeproot Westwind Woods, near Forest cabin Find the Glass Eye to the south. The hag doesn't think it's too far away and is probably on the ground.k it's too far away and is probably on the ground.
quests.voice: I have many uses for that Glass Eye, but most importantly, they're all none of your business. Search the forest south of us, I think it fell out when I was running.

quests.name: A Little help from friends
quests.description:
Hilda Deeproot
Westwind Woods, near Forest cabin

Talk to Martha.
quests.voice: Who's that? Oh, you. I can't help with your imp problem. Go ask a friend. Maybe Martha?

quests.name: Keeping the Peace
quests.description:
Quadro-Sentinel 4.1
Goldenfield, near

Go to the surrounding forests of Goldenfield and eliminate boarmammoths.
quests.voice:
You must eliminate 100 Boar Mammoth from the surrounding fields. The safety of the town - and your life - depend on it.
The goal has changed to only 10 enemies. Perhaps you can complete this within the next 10 decades.

quests.name: Power of Mana-Tech
quests.description:
D'Rek
Goldenfield, near Workshop

Head east to the edge of Goldenfield to find the ruins.
quests.voice: Don't forget, you need to retrieve the Wolf Mask from the ruins in Goldenfield. The mask holds the special code we need. It's crucial for the weapon we're crafting. Take care in the ruins. They can be quite dangerous.

quests.name: Making a withdrawal
quests.description:
Butch O'Hara
Goldenfield, near Pig farm

Head west to the Goldenfield bank.
quests.voice: Hey kid, you talk to Oswald yet? He's the only guy in town who will have the gear you want. Hopefully you won't have to rob him for it, but be open to it.

quests.name: Grizzly Shiny Glory
quests.description:
Grizzle Ironfoot
Westwind Woods, near the Old mine

Search for imp camps in the Westwind Woods.
quests.voice: I know those imps got em  out there. Check their camps and their corpses!

quests.name: Lost in Space...and Time
quests.description:
Ronny Lunar
Windreach Woods, near Crashed Spaceship.

Search the area for clues of the other crew's whereabouts.
quests.voice: Keep an eye out for any signs of other astronauts.

goals.description: Find 5 other astronauts Crew Members Documents

quests.name: Into the Woods
quests.description:
Hank Granger
Goldenfield, near Tractor.

Head to the Windreach Woods or Tempest Timberlands and kill Dendroids.
quests.voice: Just a friendly reminder: Five Dreads need to be turned into Dread pudding. Stat. The sooner you finish 'em off, the sooner I can get back to complaining about my joints and the weather.

quests.name: Obscured intentions
quests.description:
Penny "Stardust" Furbank 
Reverie Hollow, Open air dining area.

Search the gallows in Reverie Hollow for Penny's bong that has the deed hidden inside.
quests.voice:
Hey, life's a trip, right? And so is finding that deed. 
- Probably near the gallows... or maybe I imagined that? Anyway, enjoy the vibes!

quests.name: Gathering the Fragmented
quests.description:
Mary Jane Greenpuff
Windreach Woods, Road house.

Help people at the Lakehouse, the Old Quarry, the Old Portal, and the Falling Planes in exchange for artifact pieces.
quests.voice: Don't forget to pick up the artifact pieces and deliver the herbs. The artifact pieces are at the Lakehouse, the Old Quarry, the Old Portal, and the Falling Planes. And remember, the herbal deliveries are for Triton, Alexander Stones, Driscoll-99, and Clanker. Seriously, don't make me do my job myself. I just took some herbal supplements and can barely walk.

quests.name: Brave New World - The Final Test
quests.description:
Zugg Clankwhistle 
Goldenfield, near the Bureau

Head west of Reverie Hollow in the Westwind Woods.
Deliver the generators back to Zugg
quests.voice: Remember, it's the shuttle in the forest. Big crash with shit everywhere. Some folks in Reverie Hollow say they head an explosion to the west of em , shouldn t be too difficult to find a giant spacecraft on fire! Reports say it s pretty deep in the Westwind Forest, so you re probably going to need some hiking boots and a sharp stick. Just keep your eyes open.

quests.name: Package Pilfered
quests.description:
Rusty Bowen
Windreach Woods, Railway stop near Fort.

Kill fungus around the Windreach Woods.
quests.voice: Get your ass moving, those fungi aren't gonna hunt themselves. Those sneaky little jerks are somewhere in the Windreach Woods. Shouldn't be far.

quests.name: Bridging Realms with Friends
quests.description:
Driscoll-99 
Westwind Woods, Old Portal.

Find Pastor Fazool in Reverie Hollow to the southwest. Quest-O-Tron is southeast of the Hunter's Lodge and Grizelda is far east, just southwest of the Abandoned Railway Station.
quests.voice: Oh, just a friendly reminder! To unlock realms, first a visit to Pastor Fazool in Reverie Hollow. Delightful chap talks to ancient entities!  Next on our jolly list is Grizelda in Windreach Woods. And don't forget the ever-charming QUEST-O-TRON in Windreach Woods.  Remember, you'll need to 'earn' their trust. Whatever that means. Survival and happiness await!

quests.name: Decrypting Betrayal
quests.description:
Louise Oldgarden 
Reverie Hollow, Pastor s house.

Kill 10 dreads around the forest.
quests.voice: Hey, you kill any Dreads yet? Pastor Fazool's counting on us. Don't forget, the quicker we get that proof, the quicker we save the day. And the quicker Fazool rewards me - I mean, us.

quests.name: Fungal Phobia
quests.description:
Lingua 
Reverie Hollow, Freshwater Well.

Kill Fungus around the forests then use Lingua's sewing kit to craft a stuffed fungus creature.
quests.voice: Hey fungus master, you got those Fungus Exoskeletons yet? Kill some Fungus around the forest to get them. Imagine Fazool's face when he sees this stuffed fungus monster in his room! Priceless!

quests.name: The painted betrayal
quests.description:
Pastor Fazool 
Reverie Hollow, Church.

Check the paintings in the barn.
quests.voice: Check the paintings in the barn. They might contain the messages we're looking for.

quests.name: Facing the flame
quests.description:
Zugg Clankwhistle
Goldenfield, near the Bureau

Find the old hag at the forest cabin north of the quarry in the Westwind Woods.
Get Imp leaders brains
Put the Imps brains to cloning tank
quests.voice:
You'll find her out in them woods, northwest up the road from the spaceship wreck. Her gross house is deep in the Westwind Woods. Ask her what in the world smacked my shuttle, will ya?
Wonderful! Bring the brains to my house. Then put them into the cloning tank. It's all AI controlled and very easy.
Looks like their bigwigs ain't as dim as they seem. Alright, let's make a deal and have some fun   off those leaders and bring me their brains, the fresher, the better.

goals.description: Learn the details of the disaster from the old hag

quests.name: Fragments of the Forgotten
quests.description:
Mary Jane Greenpuff
Windreach Woods, Road house

Find the ruins east of Goldenfield, past the Thornbuckle farm.
quests.voice: Hey, keep your vibes tuned in! The artifact is waiting for you in those trippy ruins. Remember, the ruins hold deep secrets, man. Keep your mind clear and your senses sharp. And then hope nobody got there and like, bogarted the relic before us.

goals.description: Go to the ruins to look for the artifact

quests.name: Portal Perils
quests.description:
Driscoll-99
Westwind Woods, Old Portal.

Kill timbers around the forest.
quests.voice: Don't forget, we need those Timbers DEAD to move forward! Get the amber off their corpses, and bring it back to me. You can also get it without killing, but that doesn't seem fun! It's a vital ritual for restarting the portal. Try not to get any Timber splinters in an open wound!

quests.name: Wet paper
quests.description:
Balthazar "Baz" Grimble
Windreach Woods, Road house.

Search the shoreline north of the roadhouse for unpaid bar tabs.
quests.voice: Remember, search the shoreline north of the roadhouse. Check the bodies you find there; they should have some papers. Maybe even the one yer lookin' for.

goals.description: Give Pieces of Evidence to Balthazar

quests.name: Portal restorations
quests.description:
Driscoll-99
Westwind Woods, Old Portal.

Kill spiders around the forest.
quests.voice: Just a reminder, friend - I need those 10 Spiders DEAD to keep my dreams alive! Kill, kill kill, so my dreams live, live live! Or just make some strong thread yourself. Your choice!

quests.name: Confiscated Confections
quests.description:
Mary Jane Greenpuff
Windreach Woods, Road house.

Find the train tracks to the south and search for the materials.
quests.voice: Uh... what did I send you to do? Oh right! The book! No, the gear!

quests.name: The Guard's Dilemma
quests.description:
Themis
Windreach Woods, Fort.

Deliver the package to Rusty, north at the Railway Stop.
quests.voice: You need to go to the railway stop just north of the fort. Rusty Bowen should be there, disguised as a guard. He's the one that wants my dad's package... wait. Please, just take the package to Rusty. I promise it will be worth it.

quests.name: Spore-tal power
quests.description:
Driscoll-99 
Westwind Woods, Old Portal.

Kill fungus around the forest.
quests.voice: Remember, we need that precious silica from those not-so-friendly fungus creatures!  Keep a  cheery demeanor as you harvest the essence after all, this is all for a greater cause, right?

quests.name: Lost Page of Power
quests.description:
Mary Jane Greenpuff
Windreach Woods, Road house.

Search the abandoned road to the north for the lost page.
quests.voice: Whoa, I forgot I had a transmitter. Did you hear me about 15 minutes ago? Those pages, man... They might be near the abandoned road to the north, remember? Look for Deep Blue. It's probably somewhere nearby. And hey, if Deep Blue has extra drugs, swing by. I'll pay ya back. They have some interdimensional shit! Wait, how'd you say you got to Kwalat again?

quests.name: Glimmers of the past
quests.description:
Draven Torvik
Windreach Woods, Parking spot.

Search for the forest crystals to the west, across the railroad. If you hit the logging camp, you've gone too far.
quests.voice: Among the crystals, forest's grasp, lies what I seek. Cigarette folder, in the woods' embrace, awaits. Hurry, wanderer, time dances swiftly in the forest. Still trying out that poetry stuff. It's... not going well.

quests.name: No Witnesses to Glory
quests.description:
Grizelda 
Windreach Woods, Wooden mushroom house.

Search Goldenfield for 5 posters.
quests.voice: Goldenfield's got those infernal posters scattered about. Tug 'em off and rip 'em to shreds.

quests.name: Mystery of Mary Jane
quests.description:
Martha "Big Mamma" Potterson
Goldenfield, near Welfare kitchen.

Head northwest to the Road House in Windreach Wood and find Mary Jane Greenpuff
Martha "Big Mamma" Potterson
Goldenfield, near Welfare kitchen.

Check on Mary Jane Greenpuff at the Road House in Windreach Woods.
quests.voice: Remember, Road House to the northwest in Windreach Woods. If Mary Jane isn't a monster snack by now, she should be there. She's probably trying to commune with a shrub again...

quests.name: The hunt for Green Puff
quests.description:
Themis
Windreach Woods, Fort.

Search the fort for the jugs and papers.
quests.voice: Okay, uh, just a reminder... those jugs and pages are hidden in the fort. And uh, try not to get caught. My father is out on some errand right now, but if he comes back, he's going to execute us both. I can't stress enough how important it is to stay under the radar. I like my head far away from my ass.

quests.name: Pages to protect
quests.description:
Mary Jane Greenpuff
Windreach Woods, Road house.

Find Draven south of the Roadhouse. Balthazar is southwest at the parking spot.
quests.voice: Hey, remember, those pages... Draven Torvik and Balthazar might have 'em. Balthazar should be like, just around here! And Draven... he's just south of the fort.

quests.name: Nature's redemption
quests.description:
Mary Jane Greenpuff
Windreach Woods, Road house.

Bring the set to the Themis at the Fort to the south west.
quests.voice: Themis should be easy to spot. Look for the innocent-looking guard who seems out of place. Wait, shouldn't you be at that fort? It's southwest of us in the forest Duderino. Don't forget, we're counting on you. By we, I mean me and the universe. And all my customers.

goals.description: Bring the assembled set to Fort Themis

quests.name: JuRicksic Quest
quests.description:
Pappy Rick 
Windreach Woods, Fisher house.

Help Pappy Rick collect 3 Meteoric Metal to create a girlfriend for Quest-O-Tron and prevent an assassination.
quests.voice: Hey, genius, you plan on getting that Meteoric Metal, or did a squirrel distract you?  It's been about five minutes too long since I told you to fetch that shit. Chop-chop!

quests.name: Feathers and Fury
quests.description:
Lily Baxter
Goldenfield, South farm

Choke 6 chickens around Goldenfield.
quests.voice: Remember, six chickens. Don't chicken out now!

quests.name: A fateful bet
quests.description:
Dr. Glimmiwop
Goldenfield, Distant Farm.

Find Beeswax around Nia, then locate Petroleum by D'Rek.
quests.voice: To set the wheels in motion for our legal endeavor, bring fresh skincare oils to Dicey in Windstone Village. Every wrinkle tells a story, but let's not make it a horror story, shall we?

quests.name: Glimmer of Inovation
quests.description:
Eamon Hardich
Westwind Woods, Sawmill Workers yard.

Collect batteries from around the settlement.
quests.voice: Collect those batteries and take em' to - hic - Fen -hic - Fenwick.

quests.name: Mystery of the Masks
quests.description:
Dorik Oakenshield
Westwind Woods, Old Quarry bottom

Search around the quarry for three myserious masks.
quests.voice: Keep yer peepers peeled and yer wits sharp! Those masks ain't gonna jump out on their own, ya know! Remember, laddie, the spookier it feels, the closer ya probably are! Check everywhere in this here quarry.

quests.name: The Heart of the forest
quests.description:
Grommuk Ironhand
Westwind Woods, Sawmill centre

Collect the chainsaw, chain and gasoline around camp.
quests.voice: Grrr, you find chainsaw yet? Gather chainsaw, gas and chain. Grrr, quick! Grrr, hurry! Need work done! Time is gold!

quests.name: Lawsuit of the Lake
quests.description:
Triton
Windreach Woods, Lake house.

Help people around the area for notes to help in his lawsuit.
quests.voice: Don't forget notes! Seaonna and Mariel Venomtail by Mermaid Lake.  Ol' Fins on Windstone Lake Pier, Zorbul and Glimmiwop on Distant Farm, Glubgrath near Gemini Lake.  Get notes for Triton's big legal drama, you get shiny artifact. Fair deal!  No notes, no artifact! Triton not babysitter, find baby-haters youself.

quests.name: From Seaonna with love
quests.description:
Seaonna
Windreach Woods, Mermaid Lake

Search north east above Ludwig Shatten for the Pulsating Sphere.
quests.voice: Hurry! Triton is waiting, and I can't lose him! Please, the rare flower from the pulsating sphere north in Windreach Woods. We need it now!

quests.name: Whispers in the Woods
quests.description:
Dorik Oakenshield
Westwind Woods, Old Quarry bottom

Search the old house to the north east of the quarry.
quests.voice: Oi, I hope ye haven't gotten tangled up with those shadowy folk in that haunted house by the quarry! Remember, it's just North East of us. I knew it! Yer part of the conspiracy, aren't ye? Prove yer not by findin' those bloody clues!

quests.name: Unmasking the conspiracy
quests.description:
Alexander Stones
Westwind Woods, Old Quarry overlooking platform.

Wander through the mines looking for weapons.
quests.voice: Oi, I hope ye haven't gotten tangled up in those mines  we just need the weapons outta there. I knew it! Yer part of the conspiracy, aren't ye? Prove yer not by findin' those bloody clues!

quests.name: Kill the maker
quests.description:
QUEST-O-TRON 
Windreach Woods, Camp near the shrine.

Venture to the Destroyed Bridge in the Windreach Woods, then search the crashed spaceship. Search trees around Goldenfield and finally stop at the Book Stop for Pappy's items.
quests.voice: Are you dense? Binoculars, barbell, plant in a pot, T-shirt. Find 'em! Binoculars at the Destroyed Bridge, barbell at the Crashed Spaceship, plant in a pot at Trees, and a T-shirt at the Book Stop. I can't tutorialize this any better, dummy. Go!

quests.name: Funds of Faith
quests.description:
Grizelda 
Windreach Woods, Wooden mushroom house.

Go south east across the road and search the abandoned houses in the forest. Her stash is in one of them.
quests.voice: Well, goddamnit! Did you find that satchel yet or not?  Don't you dare waste my time, sweetie.

quests.name: Pass the Butter
quests.description:
QUEST-O-TRON 
Windreach Woods, Camp near the shrine.

Take the jar and collect Noxious Spores from purple mushrooms. Once you get enough, combine it into a poison.
quests.voice: Rick's Fisher House: It's just south of the Destroyed Bridge. Noxious Spores, poison, yum yum. DO IT NOW. It's not rocket science, moron.

goals.description: Combine Noxious Spores it into a poison

quests.name: Fungal Devotion
quests.description:
Grizelda 
Windreach Woods, Wooden mushroom house.

Collect mana resin from magic trees in the forest.
quests.voice: Where the bloody hell is that Mana Resin, love? Get moving!! It's in the Magic Trees your dense son of ... loving Mushroom Minion!

quests.name: Phantom Fragment Recovery
quests.description:
Clanker
Windreach Woods, Falling planes.

Find Buck in Goldenfield and talk to him.
quests.voice: Hey, where's that kid with the artifact? Find that little shit already - he's in the Violet Weed Fields in Goldenfield. I don't want the artifact back, I just want justice.

quests.name: A Prank Too Far
quests.description:
Buck
Goldenfield, Violet Weed Field

Go to the Hunter's Lodge in the forest to the west.
quests.voice: Come on! Are you just sitting around? The Hunter's Lodge has those notes! Do I have to spell it out? Lodge. Notes. Wolves. Lily gets DEAD. The Hunter's Lodge is toward the center of Windreach Woods, South of the Famous Sword! Let's goooooooooo.

quests.name: Infiltrating Ironhand
quests.description:
Alexander Stones
Westwind Woods, Old Quarry overlooking platform.

Talk to Grommuk at the Logging Camp to the north east in the forest.
quests.voice: Remember, every log you chop is another step closer to the truth! Stay vigilant, those aliens could be hiding anywhere. Specifically, in Grommuk, who you NEED to talk to.

quests.name: Digging Deeper
quests.description:
Alexander Stones
Westwind Woods, Old Quarry overlooking platform.

Talk to Dorik in the Old Quarry.
quests.voice: Hey, remember, the truth is down at the bottom of that damn quarry! Keep your eyes peeled for anything the mainstream media doesn't want you to find.

quests.name: Revenge of the Rabbit
quests.description:
Buck
Goldenfield, Violet Weed Field.

Kill an Alpha Wolf for their brain. Head to Zugg's to use the cloning machine. Then, head to the farm to the west and clean them up in the tub. Lastly, search for a skeleton off the fork in the road to the south west outside of town.
quests.voice: Hey, dummy! Did you forget the Alpha Wold brain!? Kill those things in the forest, duh! What's taking so long? Hurry up, I need those brains for my prank!

goals.description: Collect brain of an Wolf Alpha
Clone a brain and get a double Wolf Alpha brain
Clean the double brain Wolf Alpha

quests.name: A Fishy Summons
quests.description:
Triton
Windreach Woods, Lake house.

Search the shore near Triton.
quests.voice: Triton need notes from lakehouse. No forget! Big man Brawny wait for papers. Serve him right! Find Brawny near gym in Windstone Village. Triton bet he flexing muscles like he Conan!

quests.name: The big reveal
quests.description:
Grommuk Ironhand
Westwind Woods, Sawmill centre.

Find Alex at the old quarry to the south.
quests.voice: Bring pot to loud man on radio... Alexander... Stones... It is gift.

goals.description: Return Rumbling Green pot to Alexander Stones

quests.name: Fish Prophet's Decree
quests.description:
Ol' Fins
Windstone Vallage, Windstone Lake's.

Search the shores of the lake to the west for lures and rope.
quests.voice: Don't forget the rope and luresss, the ansssient one drawsss near.

quests.name: The Siren's Temptation
quests.description:
Seaonna
Windreach Woods, Mermaid Lake

Kill leaf monsters around the forest and collect Verdant Leaves.
quests.voice: For Poseidon's sake, do it already! The ocean's not getting any deeper but my patience is running thin. If you don't get those Verdant Leaves soon, I'll lose Triton faster than a guppy in a shark tank!

quests.name: Catch of the day
quests.description:
Thorin Toastbeard
Windstone Village, Tavern.

The tavern is in the south east side of Windstone Village.
quests.voice: You pick up those blue bottles yet? Don't need someone else findin' 'em. Remember how your ex was always full of surprises? Yeah, these bottles are like that, but less emotional damage.

goals.description: Collect Secret Snack bottles in the Tavern

quests.name: The Little Terror
quests.description:
Lil Timmy
Goldenfield, Edge farm.

Help Hank and Marigold to keep 'Lil Timmy's ass out of trouble.
quests.voice: Now don't forget, you gotta chat with my mommy and daddy!  Oh, and make sure all the chores are done,  kay?  I'm depending on you, big friend!

quests.name: The Real Culprit
quests.description:
Claudine Baxter
Goldenfield, South farm

Find 'Lil Timmy at his farm in north eastern Goldenfield.
quests.voice: Remember, the stolen artifact is likely with 'Lil Timmy at Edge farm.  Especially cause I'm already starting to forget.

quests.name: The Prankster's Peace
quests.description:
Buck
Goldenfield, Violet Weed Field.

Search abandoned houses outside of town to the west for a clock. Combine it with the package and deliver to Lily.
quests.voice: Hey! Did you get the clock yet? That timer's ticking down, ya know! Come on, it's not gonna hurt anyone... just find the stupid clock at that abandoned house I found.

goals.description: Pack the box with the watch

quests.name: Vanity's Elixir
quests.description:
Zorbul Z'nar
Goldenfield, Distant Farm.

Search the South Farm in Goldenfield in the South East corner.
quests.voice: Find shinies! Special water in odd herb bottles, South Farm!  Zorbul wait for the shiny water, from herbs it flows!

quests.name: Strange Green Pots
quests.description:
Oakley "Dusty" Fenn
Windreach Woods, Sawmill kitchen.

Find Dendroid Keepers in the forest around the sawmill.
quests.voice: Hey man, get out in the forest and take out some of those Dendroid Keepers. Grommuk's waiting and he's not going to wait forever, dude.

quests.name: Herbal Remedy
quests.description:
Claudine Baxter
Goldenfield, South farm.

Search the South Farm for barrels containing Skull Crusher Weed.
quests.voice: Have you got my skull crusher weed yet? They're at the South Farm. I buried them in barrels. You know, the one I live at?

quests.name: Nuts for the Stew
quests.description:
Fenwick "Fen" Harrow
Westwind Woods, Sawmill Workers yard.

Take the batteries and put them in the generators around camp, then turn on the main transformer.
quests.voice: Get those generators up and running with those batteries... then uh... shit... Oh yeah... stop and see Dusty.

quests.name: Amplify the Catch
quests.description:
Ol' Fins
Windstone Village, Windstone Lake's.

Go the market in Windstone Village to the east.
quests.voice: Ssswim swiftly, adventurer... the goal awaitsss in the market, Windssstone Village. The fish gods grow impassssient. Bring the sssstolen microphone before they sssink into a sullen slumber.

quests.name: Portal Purge Parade
quests.description:
Driscoll-99 
Weswind Woods, Old Portal.

Search the area and kill the monsters.
quests.voice: Hehehe, these creatures are just itching to meet you! Seek them out and remember it s all in the name of balance, right?  Kill a Dendroid, a Spider, and a Timber.

quests.name: Fowl Play
quests.description:
Lily Baxter
Goldenfield, South farm

Search the rat field for the scythe.
quests.voice: Don't forget, you need that bloody knife from Rat Field! Remember to find the knife and sneak it to Buck in the Violet Weed Field. Then we SEND. HIM. TO. PRIIIIIISON!

quests.name: It's Just a Prank, Bro!
quests.description:
Lily Baxter
Goldenfield, South farm.

Talk to Claudine at her farm in eastern Goldenfield.
quests.voice: Don't leave me hanging, big meanie! My mom needs to know what you did!

quests.name: Whispers in the Dark
quests.description:
Varkus Drov
Westwinds Woods ,Old mine near sawmill.

Talk to Alexander in the Old Quarry to the south,
quests.voice: Time is ticking. My name needs clearing. Talk to Alexander yet?

quests.name: Beauty in the Mud
quests.description:
Zorbul Z'nar
Goldenfield, Distant Farm.

Head straight east to the lake. Search around the shore for eggs.
quests.voice: Zorbul need eggs from water dinosaurs. Face depends on turtle egg yolk! Find around lake or from turtles. Take their babies!

quests.name: Desperate Depths
quests.description:
Varkus Drov
Westwind Woods, Old mine near sawmill.

Defeat Razorleaf Swarms around the forest.
quests.voice: Don't forget to kill those Razorleaf Swarms... It's a grotesque task, but necessary for... reasons.

quests.name: A Special Meal for Timmy
quests.description:
Marigold Thornbuckle
Goldenfield, Edge farm.

Head south to the Baxter's farm in Goldenfield.
quests.voice: Now, don't forget, honey, the herbs are in the green jug with rope at the south farm, alright?  Remember to be sneaky, dear. We wouldn't want those busybodies at the farm getting in our business.

quests.name: Beneath the Surface
quests.description:
Alexander Stones
Westwind Woods, Old Quarry overlooking platform.

Find a lamp in the abandoneded buildings, then head north to the abandoned settlement and find mine cart parts.
quests.voice: Those clue fragments in the mine are pieces of the grand puzzle. Don't let the lizard overlords distract you! Keep digging! Get that mine cart in working order and get down that shaft! Grab a lamp nearby and go north to the Abandoned Settlement and find those parts for the cart.

goals.description: Collect 5 Parts for the mine car

quests.name: A Taste of the Unusual
quests.description:
Erwin "Bacon King" Braux
Riverrise, Butchery district.

Head to the abandoned village south or the railway depot and swamp to the east for scrags.
quests.voice: Don't let me down! Get those bones for Rufus. Find scrags around the village south, or over by that railway depot to the east.

quests.name: Lost Signal
quests.description:
Lyra Thornfeld
Westwinds Woods, Valley of sins infistation

Head north west to the Greystone Ruins and place a radio. Continue north west and find the second anomaly.
quests.voice: Focus, recruit. We need you to get those radios out there. Keep your eyes peeled. The area is treacherous, but we need those comms operational.

quests.name: Love Potion No. 9
quests.description:
Spade
Riverrise, Minibar in the upper part.

Head south to the Bog Slums. You'll find it just eas tof the Starbark Groves.
quests.voice: I need those vials. Hurry up. Bog Slums... and be careful. They mayor - er, the man - will be here soon.

quests.name: Unsavory Evidence
quests.description:
Gusto Grubhunter
Windstone Village, Guard's place: south west.

Head south into the woods. The abandoned house is past the railroad tracks.
quests.voice: Don't fuck this up! Head to the abandoned house on the hill for the pan and that delicious... I mean TWISTED recipe for baby stew. You'll find the house just south of Windstone Village! After, remember Quaridor Vex is your final stop. He's patrolling near the Guard's place in west Windstone Village.

quests.name: Mounting Evidence
quests.description:
Roderick "DarkSpike" Thinklatch
Windstone Village, Guard's place: east.

Search the Windstone Village Pier on the west side of the village.
quests.voice: Courage is looking chaos in the eye, kid. Scour those nets and containers at the lake. The recording device is out there, waiting.

quests.name: A Question of Honor
quests.description:
Themis
Windreach Woods, Fort

Talk to Alaric Stormshade at the fort in Windreach Woods to face the consequences of your crime.
quests.voice: H-Have you reported to Alaric yet? He's, uh, waiting at the fort...please, don't delay.  Seriously. The longer you wait, the worse it is.

quests.name: Price of Punishment
quests.description:
Ace
Riverrise, City Center.

Search for boars in the woods west of Riverrise, past the fields.
quests.voice: Tick-tock, baby. Boars aren't gonna fly into your lap and cut themselves open for you, and neither will I. Hustle!

quests.name: The Final Verdict
quests.description:
Baxton "Skip" Malroth
Windstone Village, Guard's place: west.

Return to Triton on the north side of the lake.
quests.voice: C'mon, haven't you nailed Triton with that summons yet? That fish-face is still lounging by the lake house in Windreach Woods. Get a move on!

quests.name: Diamond eyes
quests.description:
Durzo "Dicey" Dunwaddle
Windstone Village, Guard's place: east.

Use the items around the Dr. to help him create a beautiful set of eyes for Dwarfaton.
quests.voice: Head over to Dwarfaton in Windstone Village and help him with his eyes.

quests.name: Desperate for Dendroid
quests.description:
Marigold Thornbuckle
Goldenfield, Edge farm.

Head south to the house on the edge of the fields and find the cookbook.
quests.voice: Oh dearie, have you fetched that cookbook yet? Lil' Timmy's patience is running thin! We can't keep Timmy waiting, you know how he gets. Or at least... you will.

quests.name: Questionable Evidence
quests.description:
Quaridor Vex
Windstone Village, Guard's place: west.

Look at the docks in Windreach Woods for a vase with the mask. You can also search south of here in the trees. Just don't go past the road south.
quests.voice: Search around the docks, or head south and check the trees for vases.

quests.name: Breaking the Chains
quests.description:
Marigold Thornbuckle
Goldenfield, Edge farm.

Grab the smoker from near 'Lil Timmy and head north across the field to the hive. Use the smoker on the hive, retrieve the bottle and bring it back.
quests.voice: Did you get my toy? What are you doing? And definitely don't bring it to my momma! Whatever she says is wrong.

goals.description: Take the toy out of the hive.

quests.name: Eight Legged Freaks
quests.description:
Ophelia Voss
Riverrise, Bench behind the alchemy.

Search for spiders south in the Ripplecrop Fields
quests.voice: Have you crushed those disgusting bugs yet? I'd hate for you to miss the 4:00 PM tea time...

quests.name: Eggcellent substitution
quests.description:
Triton
Windreach Woods, Lake house.

Kill imps in the Windreach Woods and collect eggs.
quests.voice: HELLO? TRANSMITTER WORKING!? Hurry, imps not wait long! Remember, need eggs. Look sharp! Triton more hungry, not wait forever.

quests.name: Echoes of Paranoia
quests.description:
Alexander Stones 
Westwind Woods, Old Quarry overlooking platform.

Save the hostages in the Westwind Quarry from the Ravager.
quests.voice: Remember, Varkus is hiding something big, real big. Don't let him slip away! Find those hostages who know what Varkus did. Westwind Quarry, the Ravager probably has the key!

quests.name: Disorderly Consequences
quests.description:
Alaric Stormshade
Windreach Woods, Fort

Pick up the paper and take it to Lyra.
quests.voice: Lyra said you didn't report to the infestation yet. Head south to Westwind Woods, towards the Quarry. Due West from there. Can't miss it! Tick-tock. The longer you dawdle, the happier I become about your future in a cell.

quests.name: Tides of Vengeance
quests.description:
Mariel Venomtail
Windreach Woods, Mermaid Lake

Search the Hunter Camp to the east for the pages.
quests.voice: Still haven't got those notes? What's wrong, too scared to look around Ludwig's camp? I saw him heading East into the forest! Go find him! Every second you waste is another second I'm considering dragging you under. Tick-tock.

quests.name: Something Suspicious
quests.description:
Alexander Stones
Westwind Woods, Old Quarry overlooking platform.

Search the mine to the south, nearby Grizzle Ironfoot for the notes.
quests.voice: Can't ignore the feeling someone's watching us. Be quick, they might already know we're onto them! Get those notes before they can cloak 'em. This is our only shot.

quests.name: The Art of Deception
quests.description:
Hank Thornbuckle
Goldenfield, Edge farm.

Head to the Goldenfield Bank.
quests.voice: Remember, we need four specific paintings for Lil' Timmy.  The bank will have 'em sitting out somewhere. Just look around.

quests.name: Culinary diplomacy
quests.description:
Thorin Toastbeard
Windstone Village, Tavern.

Search for the Overgrown House to the north east of town. Professor Zephyr Yule should be around.
quests.voice: Don't forget, the special herb is in purple jars near the Overgrown House. Those eggs won't stay fresh forever, so chop-chop! Head northeast outside town in the Skylight Grasslands quickly! If you get lost, you're on your own.

quests.name: Corruption Clean-Up
quests.description:
Morick Voss
Westwind Woods, Valley of sins infestation.

Kill some Occultists around the area.
quests.voice: Keep cleaning up those Occultists, 'cause we can't have Lyra piecing things together, now can we? If she was distracted by... loss, she uh... won't have time to sign your service form.

quests.name: The Case Against Triton
quests.description:
Brawny Barrelbuckle
Windstone Village, Street gym.

Find Roderick 'DarkSpike' Thinklatch in Windstone Village.
quests.voice: Move it, champ! Time to hustle to the Guards' Place in Windstone Village and see what Roderick 'DarkSpike' Thinklatch has on our slippery friend Triton.

quests.name: Seasoned delicacy
quests.description:
Triton
Windreach Woods, Lake house.

Find Thorin in Windstone Village to the east, past the lake.
quests.voice: Eggs get cold! Triton need herbs soon. Thorin make taste good. Hurry! Windstone Village far! Must go fast!

quests.name: Unveiling Dark Secrets
quests.description:
Alexander Stones
Westwind Woods, Old Quarry overlooking platform.

Search for an abandoned house south of Varkus.
quests.voice: Don't forget, head south of the Abandoned Gold Mine. That's where Varkus stashed the body-like a bad episode of 'CSI: Iron Mountains'! Stay sharp! The truth is buried, but those conspiracy creeps left clues out there.

quests.name: Toxic Ambition
quests.description:
Soko Uno
Riverrise, Scene

Go to the souther Riverrise bridge. Cross it and head directly east across the river into the woods.
quests.voice: Ahem, remember, my hidden vial of toxins! It's for the greater good of art. My art! Mind the notes, darling, this stuff is extremely dangerous! Handle with all the grace of my vocal cords.

quests.name: The fisherman's bash
quests.description:
Glubgrath
Skylight Grasslands, Gemini Lakes.

Go to Windstone Village to the east.
quests.voice: Remember, find Thorin Toastbeard near the Tavern in Windstone Village for the sssnacks.  It'ssss almost party time.

quests.name: Guarding Fortunes
quests.description: Themis Windreach Woods, Fort. Kill some Dendroid Scouts around the forest.
quests.voice: Uh, s-so, um, have you seen any of those 3 Dendroid Scouts yet? I, uh, just wanted to check if you've, you know, dealt with them...

quests.name: Guarding green
quests.description: Themis Windreach Woods, Fort. Kill some Dendroid Scouts around the forest.
quests.voice: Hey, man, you still gotta find Themis. That dude's just chilling at the fort, totally clueless about the artifact. It's South down the road. Then go West to the curve. Can't miss it! Better hurry - who knows what the hell those guys will do with it.

quests.name: Farmyard Mayhem
quests.description:
Hank Thornbuckle
Goldenfield, Efge farm.

Head north to the Ripplecrop Fields and collect spider eggs on the ground or off of spiders.
quests.voice: Son, you gotta step up and take care of those spider eggs. Show Timmy what real bravery looks like. Get out there and protect our farm, it's what any real man would do.

quests.name: Heartbreak waters
quests.description:
Mariel Venomtail
Windrach Woods, Mermaid Lake.

Find Ivie Clarkson in Goldenfield.
quests.voice: Remember, it's Ivie Clarkson at Goldenroast Cafe in Goldenfield. The quicker she gets the letter, the quicker we break that heart, the quicker I get to eat!  Pull out those acting skills. Make her believe Ludwig's as done with her as a Torkon executioner with a broken guillotine.

quests.name: Slippery Passage
quests.description:
Chad "Buzz" McNulty
Riverrise, Scene.

Go south of the Ripplecrop Fields to the Train Station. Kill scrags to find a key and save the hostages.
quests.voice: Please, please find those guys. I need them for mosh pitting, and they re also like  super nice guys.

quests.name: Behind Enemy Lines
quests.description:
Trevor Barlow
Windreach Woods, Fort.

Search the captain's trunks around the fort for his Calming Leaves.
quests.voice:
You found that stack of paper yet? Time's ticking and dark magic isn't forgiving. Remember, the longer you take, the more power that artifact can gain. We can t let that happen.
You found those leaves yet? Time's ticking and dark magic isn't forgiving.

quests.name: Strumming Sorrow
quests.description:
Felix
Riverrise, Musical Instrument Shop.

Search the bars around Riverrise for the reciept and return it to Bart.
quests.voice: My feet long to dance, but I need that chance, scour the bars, start the prance! Swiftly now, seek the hidden clue, search the bars, it's there, I knew! Every note I croon, feels like doom, find that slip, end my gloom!

quests.name: Unbottling Mercy
quests.description:
Rufus
Riverrise, Butchery district.

Head to the first field northwest and search for the bottle..
quests.voice: Bark! Zeek and Erwin, knives ready! Fetch bottle, save me!

quests.name: Mana Market Resupply
quests.description:
Gimlor
Riverrise, Mana market.

Use your tradeskills to craft mana flasks.
quests.voice: Hey champ, picture this: resin = golden future! Don't forget that stuff is our ticket to stardom!

quests.name: Darkwood Dilemma
quests.description:
Tharkon
Windreach Woods, Fort.

Search for the Captain's body near the Altar north of the Quarry and collect any proof you find.
quests.voice: Hey, don't drop the ball now. The Captain's life and ours depends on you getting your act together. Find his body, and report back to Trevor. Come on, partner. If the Quaddari are behind this, we're sitting ducks. Hustle up! Get deep into those Southern woods and bring our boy back!

goals.description: Pick up an item near the corpse as proof of death

quests.name: Threading the Dream
quests.description:
Lila Algernon
Riverrise, Scene.

Go to the fields outside Riverrise and kill spiders.
quests.voice: Hey, you didn't forget about that stuff, right? I need  3 Spider Queens, 9 Spider Babys taken out, pronto!  Come on, dude! Zara's show is almost here, and I'm sweating like a chicken in a frying pan!

quests.name: The Melody of Misfortune
quests.description:
Bart Blaine
Riverrise, Musical Instrument Shop.

Find Felix and take the horn to him.
quests.voice: A new torment awaits at the Post Office. Hurry, before Felix weaves another tragic tune!

quests.name: Copper Snack
quests.description:
Rusty McDrinkit
Riverrise, Alcohol truck.

Head to the Railway Depot south east of Riverrise and find bolts and batteries to feed the recycling machine.
quests.voice: Processing request... hic... Have you mixed those ingredients yet? ...hic. Keep searching... hic... Bolts and batteries are critical... for gratitude... hic ...protocol.

goals.description: Bring delicious liquid to Maverick "Mav" Gritt

quests.name: Cigar Tales with Grizzly O'Brien
quests.description:
Grizzly O'Brien
Riverrise, Left side of the BAR yard.

Find scrags in the Abandoned Village to the south, as well as the Railway Depot and Swamps to the east.
quests.voice: Don't keep me hanging, kiddo. I'll start sober reminiscing if you don't destroy those scrags.

quests.name: A Taste to Die For
quests.description:
Gragthar
Riverrise, City Center.

Venture into the Ripplecrop Fields and search abandoned houses for pages of the cookbook.
quests.voice: What the fuck are you doing, slacking off? I just got word that they're finding them in some of those abandoned houses in the fields. I need at least 5 of those pages to even have an idea of what I'm doing... so fucking get after it!

quests.name: A Nutty Situation
quests.description:
Barkley Beats
Riverrise, City Center.

Use your cooking skill to bake some chokwalatte.
quests.voice: Clock's ticking, dawg! Don't leave me hanging like this. Get that damn chokwalatte, pronto!

quests.name: The Meat of the Matter
quests.description:
"Zeek" Solomon
Riverrise, Butchery district.

Gather Rawstead Carcass and Grylld Carcass. Some say they're best over a fire.
quests.voice: Got those carcasses yet? Rufus can't stay a dog forever.

quests.name: Chuckling Intervention
quests.description:
Bob Thurkle
Riverrise, Scene.

Search old bushes for rare Chuckleberry leaves.
quests.voice: Don't forget to bring those Chuckleberry leaves, man. We need them to get Cherry back on track. Check in those old bushes! We can't let Soko swoop in and steal the limelight.

goals.description: Return Chuckleberry Leaves to Zazz Blorb

quests.name: Feeding Frenzy
quests.description:
Max Starchaser
Riverrise, City Center.

Head to the swamps north of the marshes.
quests.voice: Remember, lacertians in the swamps north.

quests.name: Unmasking the Impostor
quests.description:
Bob Thurkle
Riverrise, Scene.

Go to the pier on the north east side of town and find the mask.
quests.voice: Mask. Pier. End of story.

goals.description: Return Mobius Mask to Bob Thurkle

quests.name: Thistlebrook's Terrifying Task
quests.description:
Thistlebrook
Riverrise, Bench behind the alchemy.

Complete quests for Pax and Ophelia.
quests.voice: Don't forget about Pax and Ophelia! I need to know what those creepy kids saw!

quests.name: Ancient Artifacts
quests.description:
Old Man Zephyr
Riverrise, City Center.

Look closely around the area for these objects.
quests.voice: Zephy-morp! Chasa-chasa, cheese! Zingo-bongo, bongy-bong! Import! Caffi-mak! Caffi-mak!  Pinky-mask, twerp-twerp!  Final-frinal! Calendra!

quests.name: Lucky Love
quests.description:
Zorgalon Na'Reeth
Rivverrise, City Enter 1 after the bridge.

Go east from Riverrise, past the swamp to the forest.
quests.voice: Umm... have you gotten those imps out yet? My nerves are sprouting faster than my hair! Please hurry! My date's coming up and I'm already imagining every possible way I could blow it!

quests.name: Funny Bunny
quests.description:
Barkowski
Riverrise, Left side of the BAR yard.

Head to the Creeping Marsh and kill 10 rabbits.
quests.voice: Oh, right, the ribbits! Yeah man, can you kill 10 of those tasty bastards? They're just up in the Creeping Marsh!

quests.name: Explosive Revenge
quests.description:
Maverick "Mav" Gritt
Riverrise, Alcohol truck.

Go to the TNT shop and pick up 5 explosive jugs.
quests.voice: Get off yer lazy ass and find those damn explosive bottles! Check around the goddamn TNT shop in Riverrise. Can't miss those orange jugs!

quests.name: Rehearsed Sabotage
quests.description:
Blorp Knurt
Riverrise, Scene.

Search the Creeping Marsh to the north, just above the top of the river.
quests.voice: EXCUSE ME? Are you DEAF?! I said 5 HOSTAGES THAT NEED YOUR HELP! CAN'T you FIND them? Check the CREEPING MARSH to the north, just above the top of the river.

quests.name: Catching Dreams
quests.description:
Pax Voss
Riverrise, Bench behind the alchemy.

Search for spiders south in the Ripplecrop Fields
quests.voice: Remember, the spiders exist where shadows whisper secrets. Find them before fate plays its cruel hand.

quests.name: Hidden Menace
quests.description: Trevor Barlow Windreach Woods, Fort. Track down the artifact held by a monstrous entity, kill the monster, and return the artifact to Themis.
quests.voice: That artifact is no trinket-every second you hesitate, its power festers. Dark magic doesn't wait. Confront the beast and retrieve the artifact before it claims more lives.

goals.description: Retrieve the Artifact from a Boss

quests.name: Scattered Collectibles
quests.description:
Clyde
Riverrise, Market in old town.

Search Riverrise for all the Trading Cards.
quests.voice: Remember, my masterpieces are all over Riverrise. Keep those eagle eyes sharp! Imagine those kids' faces when we beat them at their own game. There are twenty cards total, don't miss any!

quests.name: Exit Stage Left
quests.description:
Zazz Blorb
Riverrise, Scene.

Head into the Riverrise Fields to find gnats for poison. Locate the quitting papers on the table next to the stage.
quests.voice: Hurry up! The papers are on a table near the stage. The poison, well, the poison comes from the midges.

goals.description: Return Zazz's Quitting Papers to Soko Uno

quests.name: Byte's Calling Card Investigation
quests.description:
Cyra "Byte" Kessler
Riverrise, River view.

Search the bar for the hidden cards.
quests.voice: So, uh, remember to check all around the bar. For the merch, of course. Any unusual-looking cards might be it! And, totally just for Velvet Vipers stuff. These calling cards could be hidden anywhere... you know, for fans like us to find.

quests.name: The Matricidal Theory
quests.description:
Zarnok
Riverrise, City Center.

Search the city for a rat.
quests.voice: Why are you hesitating? The climax of our story awaits! Just smite that rat!

quests.name: A Fortune Forewarned
quests.description:
Reyalp
Riverrise, City Enter 1 after the bridge.

Gather these rare materials from veins, bushes and trees around the area!
quests.voice: Quick! If you don't find those ingredients, we could both end up as intergalactic laughingstocks! You must find these rare materials as soon as possible! A Gloomstone Crystal, a Sunshard Blossom, and a piece of Elderbark! Tick-tock, we're on borrowed time!

quests.name: Rock and Keg Roll
quests.description:
Lola Vexar
Riverrise, Scene.

Search the bar for the kegs.
quests.voice: Oi, don t be dilly-dallying now! We need those kegs: one red, one green, and one blue! Pronto! Remember mate, the bar's got what we need. Hurry back before this party's more busted than a badger's backside!

goals.description: Collect a Keg of beer green
Collect a Keg of beer blue

quests.name: The Last Order
quests.description:
Morick Voss
Westwind Woods, Valley of sins infestation.

Search the Valley of Sins for jars and take them to Trevor Barlow back at the fort.
quests.voice: Don't get lost out there, unless you want to become the next sample. Those jars are our lifeline to understanding the corruption. And my lifeline to avoid getting caught. Bring 'em to Trevor, and your sentence is complete.

quests.name: The Elusive Cheese
quests.description:
Seldon Moor
Riverrise, City Pier 2

Find the post office in Riverrise.
quests.voice: Did you find the cheese at the post office yet? It's ok if you didn't, we don't have to speak again.

goals.description: Pick up Cheese from the Post Office

quests.name: Exotic Attire Acquisition
quests.description:
Yassma
Riverrise, City Center.

Search the tents behind the bar for these items.
quests.voice: So, um, remember the hat, coat, pants, and t-shirt? Yeah, I still need those...

quests.name: Law and Order Protocols
quests.description:
Police-Tron 5000
Riverrise, City Center.

Look for the packages around Riverrise.
quests.voice: Operation 'Justice for All' in progress. Retrieve manifests to uphold righteousness. Failure to locate manifests equals justice malfunction. Do not let justice down.

quests.name: A Sharp Donation
quests.description:
Velvet Viper
Riverrise, City Center.

Search the bar for the knives.
quests.voice: Sweetie, get those knives before someone gets too... attached. Check every corner, darling. We can't have any more uninvited 'piercings'.

quests.name: Secrets Beneath
quests.description:
Silas Whitlock
Riverrise, Hidden Chest.

Assist Silas Whitlock in dealing with the Fungus that keeps digging up his buried chest.
quests.voice: If I end up same hole one more time, I might start charging rent to the Fungus! Ten Fungus. That's all. I'm starting to wonder if they have a union.

quests.name: The Young Woodraptor Predicament
quests.description:
Ludwig Schatten
Tempest Timberland, near the Hunter camp

Venture into the Westwind Woods to find a Young Woodraptor.
Ludwig Schatten
Tempest Timberland, near the Hunter camp

Ludwig needs your help to hunt a Young Woodraptor in Westwind Woods for his research.
quests.voice: Don't forget, we need a Young Woodraptor from Westwind Woods.

quests.name: Grimbleton's Great Recipe Hunt
quests.description:
Grimbleton
Riverrise, Alchemy.

Find Triton near the Lake house in Windreach Woods!
quests.voice: Man, I can't hold it together! I need that crazy fish oil stuff  like, yesterday! Are you getting those ingredients or what? My brain's on overdrive here!

quests.name: Study of the Wooden Deer
quests.description:
Ludwig Schatten
Tempest Timberland, near the Hunter camp

Embark on a perilous hunt for a Wooden Deer in Windreach Woods for Ludwig's research.
Ludwig Schatten
Tempest Timberland, near the Hunter camp

Venture into the Windreach Woods to find a Wooden Deer.
quests.voice: Don't forget! We need you to find a Wooden Deer in Windreach Woods.

quests.name: Dismantling the Dendroid Guard
quests.description:
Ludwig Schatten
Tempest Timberland, near the Hunter camp

Venture into the Tempest Timberland to find a Dendroid Guard.
Ludwig Schatten
Tempest Timberland, near the Hunter camp

Ludwig tasks you with a dangerous hunt for a Dendroid Guard in the Tempest Timberland.
quests.voice: That Dendroid Guard isn't going to hunt itself. Off you go!

quests.name: Clean Up on Bong Island
quests.description:
Queenie Viper
Riverrise, Left side of the BAR yard.

Follow the road north out of town and look for the old house.
quests.voice: Like, seriously?! You haven't found the bongs yet? Ugh, you're sooo slow! Don't make me come down there and do it myself, hic!

quests.name: A Second Chance
quests.description:
Kira
Steppe, Fisher's camp.

Kill hyenas and collect their blood for Kira. Mark fallen brothers by anomaly to the south-east.
quests.voice: Collect Hyena blood in jar. Honour my fallen brothers. To the south-east. Markings. Under Smuggler's Island.

quests.name: Artifact of Fury
quests.description:
Zor
Steppe, Fisher's camp.

Find Slick Shady in Coal Village to the southwest of the Arid Canal.
quests.voice: Find actor man Slick Shady. I hear he southwest of Arid Canal in Coal Village.

quests.name: The Blade's Dilemma
quests.description:
Daxton Vance
Steppe, Western fort.

Search for the Westend Village northwest and look for the cursed sword. Follow to the road north to the crossroads, then head west to the village.
quests.voice: Hilt, blade, Amulet of Oaths... have you retrieved them?

quests.name: Blitz's Escape Clause
quests.description:
Blitz Hyperstorm
Steppe, Central Fort.

Follow Blitz's trail of crushed cans south into the forest. His contract should be at the end of the trail.
quests.voice: Follow the trail of crushed Zap Juice cans it's a real live wire! Clock's ticking faster than a caffeine buzz! Gotta find that contract!

goals.description: Find Blitz's contract and deliver it to Blitz

quests.name: Sunburnt Escape
quests.description:
Nud-E Leroy
Steppe, near Skeleton Cave.

Defeat Leaf Dragons around the Steppe for leaf extract. Take the extract near Nud-E Leroy and mix it up into burn relief ointment for him.
quests.voice: Kill some of them Leaf Dragons and collect leaf extract off their bodies. Then mix me up some ointment near Nud-E Leroy. Just not TOO close!

quests.name: Substances of Suspicion
quests.description:
Xelcor Zinn
Steppe, Northsteppe fort.

Collect scolopendra hormones from creatures outside the fort.
quests.voice: Once you've gathered the squishy bits, shimmy them over to Queenie she loves a good hormo-fondle!

quests.name: A Quiet Disposal
quests.description:
Finn Hawthorne
Steppe, Adventures outpost.

Head north of the outpost near the anomaly for Shroomageddon. Gather a Septic Seed from scolopendras. Finally, return to the Adventurer's Outpost and use the grinder to finish the drink.
quests.voice: Have you managed to get the Septic Seed from the scolopendra and the Shroomageddon mushroom? We need that poison! Remember to use the grinder!

goals.description: Collect Septic Seed from the scolopendra
Use a device to obtain Mindplague Essence

quests.name: A Bitter Brew
quests.description:
Furr
Steppe, Fisher's camp.

Deliver poison to the water reservoir south-west of the Great Steppe Stronghold.
quests.voice: The human reservoir is south-west of their Great Steppe Stronghold. Add the poison quietly and avoid detection.

goals.description: Poison the water in the barrel

quests.name: Stamp of Peace
quests.description:
Tor Drostin
Steppe, Central Fort.

Search for the notary northeast at the Winery.
Search for the notary northeast at the Silver Mine.
quests.voice:
Have you found Mr. Smith yet? We're barely holding on here! Get to the south winery!
This is terrible! The only other place I can think is to search the Silver Mine to the northeast.

goals.description: Find a clue about the notarys location

quests.name: A Pacifist's Dilemma
quests.description:
Brother Thaddeus
Steppe, Western fort.

Collect crystals from golems from the north for the celebration. Place the crystals in the projectors along the fort walls and speak with Madame Mirage in the Western Fort.
quests.voice: Retrieve the crystals from Golems, place them in the projects and then speak with Madame Mirage.

quests.name: An Ethical Appetite
quests.description:
Triton
Steppe, near west Lost boats.

Kill some hyenas for Triton nearby. He'll gather the meat later.
quests.voice: Kill Hyenas. Me find corpses later.

quests.name: Allergy-Free Flora
quests.description:
SNZY-04
Steppe, Junkyard slumss.

Help SNZY-04 collect rare desert plant samples north along the northern coastline. Take the samples near the Hillside Well northwest of SNZY-04 , just short of the sandy beach and use the bio-machine.
quests.voice: SIMULATING SNEEZE- Please collect samples from the plants near the lake shores and use the bio-machine to process them. -SIMULATING COUGH-

goals.description: Collect 3 specimens from Blue Desert Blooms
Collect 2 specimens from Spiky Red Cacti
Use the bio-machine to process the samples

quests.name: Silencing the Rumours
quests.description:
Tor Drostin
Steppe, Central Fort.

Help Tor Drostin remove the inflammatory posters causing unrest at the outpost.
quests.voice: For the love of all that's sacred, have ya pulled down those damned posters yet?

quests.name: Signal in the Sands
quests.description:
Colt "Muffinman" McGrady
Steppe, Great steppe stronghold.

Help Colt 'Muffinman' McGrady restore the transmission systems northwest by the village, north to the cemetery, and northeast up the road from the slums.
quests.voice: Don't forget, you need to reactivate all three transmission towers. By the village, the cemetery, and up the road from the slums!

goals.description: Report to Colt McGrady that all towers are operational

quests.name: Valuable Research
quests.description:
Rancor K'Zar
Steppe, Northsteppe fort.

Help collect valuable items north of the Northeast Fort to the southeast.
quests.voice: Don't forget, we need those... uh... valuable items for the... quantum flux recalibration. Just go retrieve them, north outside the Northeast Fort to the southeast.

quests.name: Allergic to Duty
quests.description:
Mabel Thorn
Steppe, Central Fort.

Help Mabel avoid conscription by gathering allergens between the crossroads and lake north of the Central Fort to prove her condition.
quests.voice: The Infected Saxauls are usually found around the outskirts of town.

quests.name: Shadows Beneath the Sands
quests.description:
Tor Drostin
Steppe, Central Fort.
