Head west to the Great Steppes Stronghold and sabotage the fort.
quests.voice: Get to Great Steppes Stronghold! First, steal their weapons. Then, set fire to their provisions. And drop off my special uh... gift... for Barnaby.

quests.name: Sending the Alert
quests.description:
Colt "Muffinman" McGrady
Steppe, Great steppe stronghold.

Head northwest and find the transmitter south of the Arid Canal, past the lake. The parts are located around the Great Steppe Stronghold.
quests.voice: Remember, we need all of the broken parts to fix the transmitter. Once the array is repaired, send the message to the king.

goals.description: Repair radio transmitter and call to the king

quests.name: Secrets Unearthed
quests.description:
Colt "Muffinman" McGrady
Steppe, Great steppe stronghold.

Help Colt "Muffinman" McGrady by finding the Spellbreaker Amulet to the north in the Candlewick Slums. After, head southwest to find the hidden stash.
quests.voice: Five artefacts. Spellbreaker Amulet. Coordinates. Simple enough for even you, right?

goals.description: Use the Spellbreaker Amulet to see caches

quests.name: Secrets of the Invaders
quests.description:
Furr
Steppe, Fisher's camp.

Help Furr understand the human invaders by collecting their valuables within the Adventurer's Outpost.
quests.voice: Find trinkets of humankind, from camp of Lightbearers. In chests, in tents, upon soldiers they rest. Seek them you must.

quests.name: Salvation from Madness
quests.description:
Zor
Steppe, Fisher's camp.

Search the Great Steppes for the dangerous, wandering Archosaur and slay it for the final artefact piece!
Take the artefact and Archosaur head to Zor at the Fisher’s Camp, or to Tor at the Central Fort. Choose wisely.
quests.voice:
Please kill the monstrous Archosaur... The final piece is what we need.
Alright laddie, bring me that artefact with the Archosaur head. Or, you can take them up to Zor... I won t put any more pressure on ya'.

goals.description: Piece of Artefact from the Archosaur
Bring piece of artefact to Zor

quests.name: The Role of a Lifetime
quests.description:
Slick Shady
Steppe, Coal Village.

Help Slick Shady by killing small Archeosaurs around different camps while he finds the artefact's location.
quests.voice: Remember, small archeosaurs. I've almost found the artefact!

quests.name: Accords and Accidents
quests.description:
HPPY-01
Steppe, Junkyard slumss.

Return the data to Dr. Queenie south at the Northsteppe Fort.
quests.voice: Every moment is joyful! Let's enhance it by delivering data to Dr. Queenie!

goals.description: Deliver HPPY-01's research data to Dr. Queenie

quests.name: Revival Overdrive
quests.description:
Zeke "Gearhead" Thompson
Steppe, Northsteppe fort.

Collect Charge Particles from defeating nearby golems.
quests.voice: Still wranglin' with those Golems? No hurry, friend. Those Charge Particles ain't goin' anywhere, and neither am I.

goals.description: Return Charge Particles to Zeke Thompson

quests.name: A Brother's Trail
quests.description:
Gideon Stroud
Steppe, North of the shore of Thousand Bones.

Following the note's directions, head south west to the coast in search for more evidence of Alaric's disappearance.
quests.voice: You uh... find any evidence in those Hyenas? Just... keep killing them until you find something.

goals.description: Return the note eaten by hyenas

quests.name: A Brother's Shadow
quests.description:
Gideon Stroud
Steppe, North of the shore of Thousand Bones.

Search for any evidence of Gideon's brother just west of the Arid Canal.
quests.voice: Please, search the area immediately west of the Arid Canal for any trace of Alaric!

goals.description: Find any traces of Gideon's brother

quests.name: Desert Diplomacy
quests.description:
Tor Drostin
Steppe, Central Fort.

Find Zor by the coastline directly north, at the Fisher's Camp.
quests.voice: Please, find Zor in his hidden village out in the northern wasteland. Remember, convincing Zor is crucial to preventing the ecological collapse.

quests.name: Thirst for Understanding
quests.description:
Furr
Steppe, Fisher's camp.

Collect poison from Mantha's explosive remains to assist Furr with his research.
quests.voice: Let Mantha explode on you. Collect... leftovers for Furr; his research depends on it.

quests.name: The Draft Dodger's Dilemma
quests.description:
Lenny
Steppe, Central Fort.

Help Lenny avoid the draft by retrieving the smut film from his lost camera.
quests.voice: Remember, you need to find that camera. Please bring the film back to me. I don't want to go to war!

goals.description: Open the safe and take the film

quests.name: The Betrayer's Blade
quests.description:
Shawna Steelheart
Steppe, Adventures outpost.

Search the battlefield, west down the road of the Great Steppe Cemetery and look for any clues.
quests.voice: Have you searched the western battlefield down the west road of the Great Steppe Cemetery yet? The bodies might hold a clue.

goals.description: Find some clues on the battlefield
Return the Broken Bayonet to Zelina Ironweave

quests.name: Spirited Away
quests.description:
Dr. Queenie
Steppe, Northsteppe fort.

Fetch liquor from the ruins to the northeast near the swamp line.
quests.voice: The ruins aren't far find the barrels and fill up some bottles.

quests.name: Sharpening Resolve
quests.description:
Silas Thorne
Steppe, Western fort.

Gather the weapon parts directly north of the Western Fort. When the road turns, continue straight north. Return with the pieces and use the anvil in the Western Fort to construct the new weapon.
quests.voice: Find the materials. Remake the weapon. Talk to Thaddeus. Time's wasting.

goals.description: Build a reinforced weapon on the anvil

quests.name: Sensing the Sands
quests.description:
Xelcor Zinn
Steppe, Northsteppe fort.

Grab four sensors from the fort and place one to the west of the South Winery. Go west and place on the rocky shore of the lake. Head east out of the fort and place one and finally to the south, just off the road.
quests.voice: Heehee! Don't forget to slip those sensors into the tripods north, south, east, and west!

goals.description: Collect 4 sensors around the northern outpost

quests.name: Defectors' Round-up
quests.description:
Roddy
Steppe, Western fort.

Daxton and Greta are around the fort. Nud-E Leroy is northwest near Skeleton Cave on the beach. Triton is around the Lost Boats north of the Skeleton Cave and Slick Shady is at Coal Village to the north. You can find Horace around the Arid Canal, northeast of Coal Village.
quests.voice: Just a little nudge those volunteers might be missing my thrilling tales by now!

quests.name: Bearing Light
quests.description:
Barnaby Thorn
Steppe, Great steppe stronghold.

Assist The Guardinator and Jennifer around the stronghold. Terrace was sent east to the Northeast Fort, you’ll find him there.
Martha "Big Mamma" Potterson  
Goldenfield, near Welfare kitchen  

Martha wants you to put the trade skills you learned to work by helping various people around the village.
quests.voice:
Jennifer and The Guardinator are around the stronghold. Terrace is to the east at the Northeast Fort, just southeast of the Northsteppe Fort.
People around here might hate you, but they aren't ones to turn down free help. Go ask around and see what you can do for them, alright? Nothing inappropriate though - and trust me, they'll ask.

quests.name: Resurrection Research
quests.description:
Madame Mirage
Steppe, Western fort.

Collect Conductive Bones from the Hyena Alpha, Elastic Bands from the Scolopendras. Deliver the items to Zeke Thompson at the Northsteppe Fort to the east.
quests.voice: You need to fetch the Conductive Bones from... hm, the Alpha Hyena, yes? The Elastic Bands from those wiggly Scolopendras! A child could do it! Take the items to Zeke. He's at the Northsteppe Fort to the east.

quests.name: Turning the Tide
quests.description:
The Guardinator
Seppe, Great steppe stronghold.

Assist the Guardinator by eliminating golems in the area. Targets reported northwest near the Great Bones Village.
quests.voice: Mission reminder: Terminate Big Golem. Terminate Tall Golem. Terminate Small Golems.

quests.name: Unearthing Obsession
quests.description:
Alex "Hooty" Howizer
Steppe, Great steppe stronghold.

Find the artefact north between the Great Steppe Cemetery and the lake. If repairs are needed, head south of its location for artefact parts.
quests.voice: Remember, the artefact is to the north, between the cemetery and the lake. If you need to repair it, check south of its location for parts.

goals.description: Find the parts of the artefact
Use an artefact to repair it

quests.name: Unearthing the Truth
quests.description:
Zor
Steppe, Fisher's camp.

Search south, past the anomaly for the fallen Lightbearer envoy near the road.
No note on body? Must be nearby. Maybe left at drop point… Look at lake to Northwest.
quests.voice:
Seek the poisoned Lightbearer messenger to the south, past the anomaly.
Look to the northwest, by the lake. Maybe it s by the drop point. Go, now!

goals.description: Find the corpse of the light-bearer with the hidden message.

quests.name: Reluctant Reinforcement
quests.description:
Biff "Dozer" Bromley
Steppe, Central Fort.

Biff "Dozer" Bromley demands that you fulfil the duties of the recruits you scared off. Head west to the Great Steppe Stronghold and Western Fort. The Northsteppe Fort is east from Biff.
quests.voice: Volunteer Army, Lightbearers, Ecological Team they're all expecting you. Get hoofin' to those outposts!

quests.name: Quelling the Rage
quests.description: Return to Zor at Fisher's Camp to figure out a solution to the Lightbearer's Artefact.
quests.voice: Take the information of the artifact s location to Zor at the Fisher s Camp.

quests.name: Proving the Steel
quests.description:
Steel Stan
Steppe, Great Bones.

Gather Lightbearer Badges east outside Great Bones Village, between the roads.
quests.voice: The badges can be collected from fallen Lightbearers east outside the Great Bones Village.

quests.name: Digging at the Truth
quests.description:
Shawna Steelheart
Steppe, Adventures outpost.

Search for the journals in their Riverrise homes. Finn and Gareth’s houses are in the northern part of town, while Zelina’s is northeast of town, over the bridge, where the road forks.
quests.voice: Head to Riverrise to search for the journals. Finn and Gareth's homes are on the north side of town, while Zelina's is just outside of town, across the river.

quests.name: Proving Loyalties
quests.description:
Zor
Steppe, Fisher's camp.

Kill the Ravager Hyena around the area to earn favour with Zor.
quests.voice: Kill Ravager Hyena. Strong, rabid beast.

quests.name: Proof of Purification
quests.description:
Ludwig Stoncap
Steppe, Dragonbane fort.

Help Ludwig gather ammo northeast past the Candlewick Slums! The mushrooms are directly east of the ammo.
quests.voice: Tick-tock fucko! Search for ammo to the northeast, past the Candlewick Slums. There should be a spot between two big sand dunes. Directly east from there, you should find a patch of mushrooms.

quests.name: Mine Over Matter
quests.description:
Greta Grubb
Steppe, Western fort.

Head north to plant land mines to defend against enemy forces. Just south of the Coal Village.
quests.voice: What's taking so long, maggot? Remember, those are live. Walk out slowly or you'll set them off.

goals.description: Be careful around mines (you have to sneak around the activated mines), place 7 landmines around the area

quests.name: Unsettling Return
quests.description:
Gareth Rucker
Steppe, Adventures outpost.

Assist Gareth with enchanting the mysterious artefact at the Quarran Altar Obelisk. Head north to the Greatsteppe Cemetery. After enchanting the artefact, take it to Barnaby for inspection.
Take the artefact to Colt in the Great Steppe Stronghold. He may know more about it.
quests.voice:
Have you enchanted the artefact at the Quarran Altar Obelisk yet? Is something in this drink you gave me? I feel a little... woozy.
Run this over to Colt, he can probably fiddle with it and unlock its true power!

goals.description: Show the artefact to Barnaby Thorn

quests.name: Unveiling the Hidden Truth
quests.description:
Jennifer Davyna
Steppe, Great steppe stronghold.

Search for an abandoned house northwest by the Great Bones Village that contains evidence of a conspiracy.
quests.voice: Shh! Make your way up northwest by the Great Bones Village. There's got to be something in one of those buildings!

goals.description: Find a way to unlock the door in the house.
Take the secret item from the house

quests.name: Loose ends
quests.description: Head down to see Tor and join in the celebration at the Central Fort.
quests.voice: Head down to Tor at the Central Fort to celebrate the end of the war.

quests.name: Evidence in the Shadows
quests.description:
Tor Drostin
Steppe, Central Fort.

Search the Great Steppes Stronghold to the west for any evidence that may uncover the secret plan.
quests.voice: We need any evidence you can find in Great Steppes Stronghold. Look for notes or documents that reveal their true intentions.

quests.name: Lights, Camera, Action!
quests.description:
Lenny
Steppe, Central Fort.

Help Lenny capture film of you killing hyenas in the Steppes for his film, avoiding any explosions.
quests.voice: Don't keep me waiting. I need you to handle those Hyenas. Dead.

quests.name: Neither Rain nor Battlefield
quests.description:
Horace Grumbles
Steppe, near East of Arid canals.

Deliver the letter to Tazara south of the Dragonbane Fort.
quests.voice: Dont forget to deliver those letters to Tazara and Pritchard at the Dragonbane Fort.

quests.name: Magnetic Intentions
quests.description:
GRMP-07
Steppe, Junkyard slumss.

Collect magnets from Enriched and Ancient veins nearby for GRMP-07 using the Ore Extractor.
quests.voice: Use my Ore Extractor to mine the magnets from Enriched and Ancient veins! They're those little things humans put on their refrigerators to distract themselves from their empty lives!

goals.description: Extract magnets from ore veins using a device

quests.name: Lost and Found
quests.description:
Zor
Steppe, Fisher's camp.

Search for broken fragments of the artefact east along the shoreline, southeast of Crystal Cave.
quests.voice: Search for fragments east along water! Southeast of Crystal Cave.

quests.name: Juice for the Journey
quests.description:
Blitz Hyperstorm
Steppe, Central Fort.

Help Blitz gather Sparkleaf Extract from the supply crates nearby so he can brew more Zap Juice.
quests.voice: Don't forget! Collect Sparkleaf Extracts from those supply crates around here... wherever 'here' is!

quests.name: Herbal Aid
quests.description:
Mary Jane
Steppe, Western fort.

Gather intoxicating flowers from the northwest, past the Westend Village. Return them to Lyra at the Western Fort.
quests.voice: Remember, gather those intoxicating flowers northwest of Westend village? It's a totally groovy spot. Oh! And the pills!

quests.name: Heartbeat of the Party
quests.description:
Zibb "The Zest" Throttlebreech
Riverrise, Left side of the BAR yard.

Find turtles around the waters of Riverrise.
quests.voice: Seek the pulse of the vibrant, the eager rhythm of life. Their energy must feed our celebration. The party wanes without the delight of the spirited. 3 turtle hearts. No more, no less.

quests.name: Harvesting the Fallen
quests.description:
Mort Decay
Steppe, Northsteppe fort.

Collect armour plates from Brisks for research purposes.
quests.voice: Get the plates... off Brisks... That way Xelcor... shuts the fuck up....

quests.name: Hangover Helper
quests.description:
Dr. Queenie
Steppe, Northsteppe fort.

Help Dr. Queenie recover from her hangover by gathering ingredients nearby for her hangover.
quests.voice: Ohhh... I shtill need... hic... some shugars and shmexy vodkas for my... shpecial shcience remedy!

goals.description: Return sugar and vodka to Queenie

quests.name: Guilt and Gears
quests.description:
Flint Thistlewick
Steppe, Great steppe stronghold.

Help Flint Thistlewick repair his steam-powered armour by collecting small gears from Small Golems.
quests.voice: Those shiny bucket-head Small Golems have my gears! Time to give 'em a tap or two!

quests.name: Fragments of Fury
quests.description:
Slick Shady
Steppe, Coal Village.

Head to the very north-west of the Silent Mountains to find the Shoreline Ruins, just south of the large island.
quests.voice: The Shoreline Ruins are in the northwest Steppe. Get there quickly and find the artefact.

quests.name: Brotherly Loss
quests.description:
Gideon Stroud
Steppe, North of the shore of Thousand Bones.

Follow the clues from the note and head towards the western coast, past Coal Village. Alaric was last seen in this area.
quests.voice: Please, follow the clues I've given you. They should lead to where he was last seen, southwest of Coal Village.

goals.description: Get proof of death of brother Gideon

quests.name: Guarding Shadows
quests.description:
Zelina Ironweave
Steppe, Adventures outpost.

Help Zelina by finding the lost gun southwest in the Candlewick Slums. Finn can be found around the Adventurer's Outpost.
quests.voice: Don't forget, we're looking for Finn's lost gun and test if that suspicious bayonet fits onto it.

quests.name: Call to Arms
quests.description:
Assist Biff "Dozer" Bromley in preparing the recruits around the Central Fort for the upcoming expedition.
 
Biff "Dozer" Bromley  
Steppe, Central Fort.

Follow the road north into the Steppes to the Central Fort where you will find Biff "Dozer" Bromley.
quests.voice:
Please, assist the three recruits and then report back to me.
Make your way up north to the Steppes and find Biff "Dozer" Bromley at the Central Fort.

quests.name: Furnishing the Future
quests.description:
HPPY-01
Steppe, Junkyard slumss.

Help HPPY-01 salvage furniture around the outpost to make the bots' outpost more welcoming.
quests.voice: Everything is absolutely splendid! Please continue collecting the chair, table, and shelf from the trash for maximum joy!

goals.description: Return pieces of furniture to HPPY

quests.name: Energised Spirits
quests.description:
Tor Drostin  
Steppe, Central Fort.  

Search for the ale to the northeast. You'll find the North Winery, northwest of the Adventurer's Outpost.
quests.voice: Don't be forgetting that Elanian Ale I asked for it might be our only hope. The ingredients should be in the north winery. West side of the bay, right?

goals.description: Throw the ingredients into the barrel of ale near Tor

quests.name: Echoes of the Feral Artifact
quests.description:
Zor
Steppe, Fisher's camp.

Follow the coastline west in search of an island, just northwest of the Lost Altar. Gideon should be residing on it.
quests.voice: Stroud find. He lead to relic. Little time. Tears of Rage grow.

quests.name: Echoes of Atonement
quests.description:
Kira
Steppe, Fisher's camp.

Follow the coastline to the north west corner of the Silent Mountains. There you will find the lost altar to experience death for yourself.
quests.voice: You're not dead yet! Go north west! Use the knife on the lost altar, end it there!

goals.description: Take the dagger from the altar

quests.name: Echoes in the Sand
quests.description:
DOPY-03
Steppe, Junkyard slumss.

Help DOPY-03 retrieve a lost lightbearer's beacon from a Hyena in the northern desert.
quests.voice: Hey, any luck finding that beacon? Look for any hyenas that have... uh... be glowing.

quests.name: Echoes from the Front
quests.description:
Barnaby Thorn
Steppe, Great steppe stronghold.

Help Barnaby gather information by finding Vexina Strider around the Stronghold.
Look for Shawna Steelheart northeast at the Adventurer's Outpost.
quests.voice:
Find Vexina Strider around the Stronghold.
Find Shawna northeast at the Adventurer s Outpost.

quests.name: Flowers for Friendship
quests.description:
BSHL-02
Steppe, Junkyard slumss.

Collect desert flowers. Follow the road northeast, nearly to the coastline. There you will find the flowers.
quests.voice: Just head northeast from the junkyard slums until you find them.

quests.name: Double Trouble
quests.description:
Terrace Tenstone
Steppe, Northeast fort.

Help Terrace by speaking with both the Rodgers' within the Northeast Fort about the draft mix-up.
quests.voice: Don't forget to talk to both those Rogers, ya know? When you've figured it out, come tell me, and we'll settle this, alright?

quests.name: Crafting Concerns
quests.description:
Lyra Vex
Steppe, Western fort.

Gather curved pipes around the fort, and assemble the weapon before delivering it to Silas.
quests.voice: Gather those curved pipes, and use the schematic to craft the weapon for Silas.

goals.description: Build a weapon on the anvil

quests.name: Deserted Hopes
quests.description:
Roddy
Steppe, Western fort.

Speak with Mary Jane Greenpuff in the Western Fort.
quests.voice: Have you had a heroic chat with Mary Jane yet? She's got the wisdom of... uh... the ancient leaf spirits!

quests.name: Desert Data Dilemma
quests.description:
Dr Queenie
Steppe, Northsteppe fort.

Help Dr Queenie obtain ecological research data from HPPY-01 northeast at the Junkyard slumss, past the South Winery.
quests.voice: Please, find HPPY-01 and his group of researchers northeast at the Junkyard slumss and get the ecological data.

goals.description: Get 6 data from the research drone group (talk with bshl-02, grmp-07, dopy-03, snzy-04, slpy-05, hppy-01)

quests.name: Desert Decryption
quests.description:
Mort Decay
Steppe, Northsteppe fort.

Help Mort Decay retrieve mysterious artefacts. Collect them to the southeast, between the Northeast Fort and the Eastern-Marsh Fort.
quests.voice: The artefacts are still out there, buried beneath the dunes. Mine away one those veins.

quests.name: The Great Pretender
quests.description:
Slick Shady
Steppe, Coal Village.

Hunt down the wandering Lizard Draco and slay it, making Slick Shady look like a hero.
Seaonna
Windreach Woods, Mermaid Lake

Slay the leaf monsters in the forest and gather Verdant Leaves.
quests.voice:
Now, don't forget to have a go at that lizard draco and make it appear as though old Slick was right in the thick of things!
For Poseidon's sake, just get on with it! The ocean won't get any deeper, but my patience is wearing thin. If you don't fetch those Verdant Leaves soon, I'll lose Triton faster than a minnow in a shark tank!

quests.name: Desert Denial
quests.description:
Mabel Thorn
Steppe, Central Fort.

Help Mabel Thorn gather evidence from the predatory plants near the border.
quests.voice: Ah-choo! Don't forget to... sniff... use the Bramble Dust on those Thornback Creepers. They're everywhere!

goals.description: Use the "Bramble dust" on Thornback Creepers
Extract "Anomalous plant" from the Leaf Queen

quests.name: Beacon of Confidence
quests.description:
Zeke "Gearhead" Thompson
Steppe, Northsteppe fort.

Find Roddy west at the Western Fort to share the news.
quests.voice: Whenever you get a chance, mosey on over and let Roddy know that beacon's buzzin' again.

quests.name: Beacon of Hope
quests.description:
Kira
Steppe, Fisher's Camp.

Collect fuses on the island northeast of Fisher's Camp and scattered around Smugglers Island and the several small islands that surround it. Afterwards, light torches along the beach, starting east of Fisher's Camp, down to the north of Silent Village.
quests.voice: Ancients scorn you. Bring funeral torch fuses from the islands to the east.

goals.description: Light the signal torches along the riverbank

quests.name: The Desert's Secret
quests.description:
HPPY-01
Steppe, Junkyard slumss.

Collect data from one of the three anomalies along the northern coast. They have been seen south of Fisher's Camp, to all the way east past the Hillside Well.
quests.voice: There's one south of Zor's camp. Just get near them and uh... get some data for me.

quests.name: A Skullful of Solace
quests.description:
SLPY-05
Steppe, Junkyard slumss.

Defeat golems and use the mechanical board reader to examine their contents.
quests.voice: Use the mechanical board reader to analyze boards from golems. Kill them if you must.

adept-item-upgrade-kit-t1.name: Adept's Item Upgrade Kit
adept-item-upgrade-kit-t1.description: Upgrades an item by one quality level. Can be used to improve Common items. Only works for Tier 1 and Tier 2 items.

adept-item-upgrade-kit-t2.name: Adept's Item Upgrade Kit
adept-item-upgrade-kit-t2.description: Upgrades an item by one quality level. Can be used to improve Common and Uncommon items. Only works for Tier 1 and Tier 2 items.

adept-item-upgrade-kit-t3.name: Adept's Item Upgrade Kit
adept-item-upgrade-kit-t3.description: Upgrades an item by one quality level. Can be used to improve Common, Uncommon, and Rare items. Only works for Tier 1 and Tier 2 items.

adrenaline-bladder.name: Adrenaline Bladder
adrenaline-bladder.description: The Adrenaline Bladder is a source of natural animal adrenaline. It is used for making stimulants.

adrenaline-rush-roll.name: Adrenaline Rush Roll
adrenaline-rush-roll.descriptionEffect:
Increase [hregen] by 3%. Duration: 20 seconds. Satiety effect:
Increase [as] by 5%. Duration: 10 minutes
adrenaline-rush-roll.description: For when you need a burst of energy or just want to feel like a hero in a high-speed chase.

amber.name: Amber
amber.description: Fossilised tree resin, Amber has natural magic-resist properties. Some say it protects you from the evil eye, but it's hard to see how.

ammunition-recharger.name: Ammunition Recharger
ammunition-recharger.description: This item is a disposable consumable designed for a single recharge of a chosen object. It allows you to restore the ammunition and functionality of a depleted item, preparing it for further use.

ancient-fossils.name: Ancient Fossils
ancient-fossils.description: Don't throw it away! It might come in handy one day.

animal-carcass.name: Animal Carcass
animal-carcass.descriptionEffect: Some kind of meat that's tender and torn apart. The tire tracks add flavor.

animal-fat.name: Animal Fat
animal-fat.description: Soft, slimy, but really useful. If you manage to get it, never throw it away.

baked-eggplant.name: Baked Eggplant
baked-eggplant.description: Very delicious and acts as a natural antioxidant.

bear-bile.name: Bear Bile
bear-bile.description: Bear Bile - An incredibly difficult resource to butcher as it takes incredible precision to remove. The foul stench is unbearable!

berries-and-cream.name: Berries and Cream
berries-and-cream.description: A perfect snack to keep you full in between meals.

blue-flask.name: Blue Flask
blue-flask.description: A flask containing a blue substance.

blue-lotus.name: Blue Lotus
blue-lotus.description: A powerful, natural antiseptic and antibiotic. Very good at increasing immunity. And what a vibrant scent!

blueberry.name: Blueberry
blueberry.descriptionEffect: Tiny flavor bombs, bursting with natural sweetness.

blueberry-pie.name: Blueberry Pie
blueberry-pie.descriptionEffect: Increase [hregen] by 2%. Increase [mregen] by 2%. Duration: 35 seconds
blueberry-pie.description: Blueberry pie for a good mood and positive attitude.

bread.description: Staple made from dough, consumed worldwide.

cabbage.name: Cabbage
cabbage.descriptionEffect: Versatile leafy green, used in salads, underestimated.

campfire.name: Campfire
campfire.descriptionEffect:
Increases [hregen] by 1.5% per sec.
Increases [mregen] by 1.5% per sec.
Food efficiency increases by 50%
Duration: 60 seconds
campfire.description: Aha. Look what I've created. I have made FIRE!

carnivorous-plant.name: Carnivorous Plant
carnivorous-plant.description: An invaluable ingredient in alchemy, it absorbs all the properties of what it consumes. So be careful what you feed it.

carrot.name: Carrot
carrot.descriptionEffect: Orange root veg, enjoyed raw or cooked, a bunny's delight.

rune-battle-cry.name: Battle Cry
rune-battle-cry.descriptionEffect:
The tank shouts, [taunt] nearby enemies within a 3-meter radius to attack them for [scale:duration] seconds.
Generates increased [aggro].
[cd] 20 seconds.

modifications.effect: Pressing the skill again increases your defense stats for 10 seconds based on how much damage you've taken from enemies under [taunt]. The more damage taken, the higher the defense boost. 10% of [pd] taken converts into [armor], 10% of [md] taking converts into [mr], and 5% of Pure [dmg] taken converts into both [armor] and [mr].
You can use this ability on an ally instead, boosting their defense stats.

rune-bolas.name: Bolas
rune-bolas.descriptionEffect:
Throws a weighted rope at the target's legs, [slow] [ms] by 40% for 3 seconds.
Range [scale:range] meters.
[cd] 10 seconds.

modifications.effect: If the target is already [slowed], they become [rooted] for 3 seconds.

rune-counterattack.name: Counterattack
rune-counterattack.descriptionEffect:
Each time the player breaks out of a [hc] effect, they can activate this ability within 5 seconds to turn the next auto-attack into an empowered counterattack that deals [[scale:damage] [ap] [pd].
[cd] 2 seconds.

modifications.effect: The counterattack pierces the target and applies a [bld] for 5 second. This [bld] deals [20% [ap]] [pd] each second, and prevents the target from entering Stealth.
When a melee warrior counterattack, they lunge 2 meters toward the enemy. For a ranged warrior, this counterattack [knockback] the enemy by 2 meters.

rune-crush-hammer.name: Crush Hammer
rune-crush-hammer.descriptionEffect:
A heavy steel hammer drops from above onto the targeted location after 0.4 second, dealing [100 + 40%[armor] + 70%[ap]] [pd] in a 1-meter radius. The impact breaks the target's [armor] by [[scale:duration] for 10 seconds, stacking up to 3 times.
Generates increased [aggro].
[cd] 7 seconds.

modifications.effect: The spot where the hammer landed becomes charged with energy and explodes after 1 second, dealing [50 + 50%[armor] + 60%[ap]] [md].
If the target is [slowed] when struck by the hammer, they are [stunned] for 1.5 seconds. Does not trigger [stun] diminishing returns.

rune-flare.name: Flare
rune-flare.descriptionEffect:
Fires a flare into the air like firework, revealing all stealthed enemies within 10 meters for [scale:duration] seconds.
[cd] 20 seconds.

modifications.effect: An eagle flies out of the flare, travels 20 meters forward, and grants vision along its path.
Upon reaching the end of its path, the eagle returns to the player and grants a buff that increases [vr] by 5 meters and reveals invisible units for 5 seconds.

rune-full-block.name: Full Block
rune-full-block.descriptionEffect:
For [scale:duration] seconds, the Tank gains a barrier that completely blocks the damage of the next incoming ability.
[cd] 15 seconds.

modifications.effect: The next blocked ability is reflected back at its caster.
The reflected ability deals 30% increased damage to its caster.

rune-glass-dust.name: Glass Dust
rune-glass-dust.descriptionEffect:
Releases a cloud of glass dust that applies [blind] and disorientation on enemies hit for [scale:duration] seconds. Any [dmg] taken removes these effects.
[cd] 30 seconds.

modifications.effect: If the target is under a burning Dot, they are covered in hot glass and become [immobilized] for 5 seconds, taking [35%[sp]] [md] every second.
On impact, also deals [100%[ap]] [pd] with glass shards.

rune-healing-hand.name: Healing Hand
rune-healing-hand.descriptionEffect:
Emits a stream of energy that [heal] the target for [80 + [scale:healing]% [hasp]].
[cd] 5 seconds.

modifications.effect: Removes one debuff from an ally or one buff from an enemy.
Steals the last-applied buff from an enemy.

rune-healing-star.name: Healing Star
rune-healing-star.descriptionEffect:
The medic throws a small clump of positive energy with a 1-meter radius. If it hits the target, it applies a [heal] over time effect (HoT) for [scale:duration] seconds that restores [20%[hasp]] [health] per second.
[cd] 4 seconds.

modifications.effect: Additionally applies Wound Healing buff. Hitting the target again instantly [heal] for [10% of the HoT total] per Wound Healing stack (max 5 stacks).

If you miss the skill shot, a small [healing] orb remains on the ground for 5 seconds. An ally stepping on it receives [heal] for [20% of the HoT total]. An enemy can step on it and crush it after 1 second, receiving [50% of the HoT total] themselves.

rune-hunters-mark.name: Hunters Mark
rune-hunters-mark.descriptionEffect:
Places a mark on the enemy for 7 seconds that increases the first instance of [dmg] they take from you by [scale:damage]% (10% + 5% per quality level). Does not apply to DoT effects. Range: 10 meters.
[cd] 10 seconds.

modifications.effect: A marked target cannot enter stealth.
Increases your [ms] by [10% + 5% per quality level] when moving toward the marked target. Stacks up to 5 times.

rune-hypnosis.name: Hypnosis
rune-hypnosis.descriptionEffect:
A Ninja-Shadow Specter flies toward the enemy with a whisper, bursts against them like a small cloud, and disappears. If it strikes the target within [scale:range] meters, it puts the foe into a [hypnosis], rendering them unconscious for 8 seconds (24 seconds for monsters). The target must not be in combat. The ability can be used from up to 12 meters away, but the effect duration is halved. Any [dmg] breaks the [hypnosis].
[cd] 20 seconds.

modifications.effect: If the target receives [hypnosis] while already a [sleep], they are afflicted with [fear] for 3 seconds. May be used in combat.
If the target receives [hypnosis] while under [fear], then if it's a player, 10% of their [mana] is burned; if it's a mob, it takes [dmg] equal to 10% of its maximum [health]. May be used in combat.

rune-ice-spike.name: Ice Spike
rune-ice-spike.descriptionEffect:
A skill shot that travels toward the target and, on collision, deals [30 + [scale:damage]% [sp]] [md]. Applies a Frostbite debuff that [slows] the target by 10% for 5 seconds, stacking up to 5 times.
[cd] 2 seconds.

modifications.effect: After accumulating 5 stacks of Frostbite next Ice Spike will freeze the target for 3 seconds. Stacks from any player.

Upon receiving Electricity damage - or if the target is currently under an Electricity DoT effect - the Frostbite status is replaced by Wet. The Wet debuff increases incoming Electricity damage by 4% per stack and can stack up to 5 times.

rune-immobilizing-trap.name: Immobilizing Trap
rune-immobilizing-trap.descriptionEffect:
Throws a trap on the ground that arms in 1 second and remains active for 1 minute. It [immobilizes] a caught target for [scale:duration] seconds. The trap is only visible within 2 meters.
[cd] 7 seconds.

modifications.effect: The immobilizing trap deals [100%[ap]] [pd] and applies a [bld] that deals [100% [ap]] [pd] over 7 seconds.
If your character is within 7 meters of a trapped target, you can pull the target toward the character while it's still in the trap.

rune-justice-of-the-sword.name: Justice of the Sword
rune-justice-of-the-sword.descriptionEffect:
The warrior concentrates and using an ancient combat technique, summons a celestial sword that falls from above onto a chosen location, dealing [100 + [scale:damage]% [ap]] [pd] to all enemies within a 3 meter radius.
[cd] 15 seconds.

modifications.effect: All players hit by the sword are [slowed] by 30% for 5 seconds.
This skill builds Fury points from damage dealt and received. If used at full Fury, the sword deals additional damage equal to 10% of the target's missing [health]. Fury subsides outside of combat.

rune-mana-donor.name: Mana Donor
rune-mana-donor.descriptionEffect:
The support buffs a target, increasing their primary attribute by 7.5% for [scale:duration] minutes.
[cd] 30 seconds.

modifications.effect: The primary attribute buff now applies to all nearby allies.
By using the ability with Shift, the support links with an ally so that ally uses the support's [mana] pool instead of their own, while increasing [mana] cost of their abilities by 20%.

rune-mana-mark.name: Mana Mark
rune-mana-mark.descriptionEffect:
The support places a mark on a target. For [scale:duration] seconds, all allies regain 0.5% of their [mana] for every instance of [dmg] they deal to that marked target. The mark drains 0.5% of the support's maximum [mana] from the user each second. The mark can only be applied to one target at a time and disappears if the support is more than 20 meters away from the target.
[cd] 5 seconds.

modifications.effect: The mark also increases [dmg] taken by the target by 2%.

The Support can reapply the mark to strengthen it. Each reapplication increases the [mana] recovery by +0.5% (up to 2.5%), but additionally increases the [mana] drained each second by 0.5%. Stacks up to 5 times.

rune-shuriken.name: Shuriken
rune-shuriken.descriptionEffect:
Throws a shuriken that deals [50% [ap]] [pd] and inflicts a [bld] for 10 seconds, dealing [[scale:damage]% [ap]] [pd] per second. Has 2 charges.
[cd] 10 seconds.

modifications.effect: Extends any [bld] (applied by the player) on the target by 3 seconds. Has 3 charges.
If the shuriken hits a target that is [stunned], the hit damage is always a [crit] strike.

rune-sleep-dart.name: Sleep Dart
rune-sleep-dart.descriptionEffect:
Fires a poisoned dart that puts the target to [sleep] for 8 seconds (24 seconds for monsters). Range [scale:range] meters. Any [dmg] breaks the [sleep] effect.
[cd] 20 seconds.

modifications.effect: Pierces the first target, striking up to two targets instead.
If the affected target was also under [fear], they have their life drained while asleep, resulting in losing 3% [health] every second (This damage is capped at 150 per tick against monster).

rune-summon-skeleton.name: Summon Skeleton
rune-summon-skeleton.descriptionEffect:
Summons a Skeleton Warrior for 1 minute. The Warrior has [[scale:warrior-health-1] + [scale:warrior-health-2]% of master's max [health]] [health]. It wields a sword and shield, dealing [[warrior-damage-1] + [warrior-damage-2]% of master's [ap]] [pd] with its basic attacks. The Skeleton generates high threat and [taunt] enemies within a 3-meter radius for 2 seconds. Drains 0.5% of max [mana] each second.
[cd] 30 seconds.

modifications.effect: Summons a Skeleton Archer that has [[scale:archer-health-1] + [scale:archer-health-2]% of Master's max [health]] [health]. It shoots arrows that deal [[scale:archer-damage-1] + [scale:archer-damage-2]% of master's [ap]] [pd] and applies a [bld] that deals [10% of master's [ap]] [pd] each second for 5 seconds.

Summons a Skeleton Healer that has [[scale:healer-health-1] + [scale:healer-health-2]% of master's max [health]] [health]. It [heal] allies and casts [shield].
Vitality Beam: The skeleton channels a beam of [healing] energy toward the summoner, restoring [[scale:healer-heal-1] + [scale:healer-heal-2]% [hasp]] [health] every 0.75 seconds. Allies in the beam's path are also [heal] for [[scale:healer-heal-3] + [scale:healer-heal-4]% [hasp]] [health]; this [healing] increases by 10% for each consecutive tick they remain within the beam.
Bone Shield: The skeleton throws a bone fragment toward the summoner. The summoner or an ally can pick up the fragment to instantly gain a [shield] that absorbs [[scale:healer-shield-1] + [scale:healer-shield-2]]% [hasp]] [dmg].

rune-tree-of-plenty.name: Tree of Plenty
rune-tree-of-plenty.descriptionEffect:
Plants a Seed that matures over 10 seconds. Once fully grown, the tree drops a magical fruit that allies can collect and store in their inventory for up to 30 minutes. Consuming the fruit restores [scale:hp]% of the user's max [health] and triggers a 1-minute fruit use [cd].
[cd] 30 seconds.

modifications.effect: When the tree matures, allied players within a 20-meter radius gain a 20% bonus to all regeneration types for 5 minutes.
Consuming a fruit removes all Damage over Time effects.

rune-tripwire.name: Tripwire
rune-tripwire.descriptionEffect:
Places a 5-meter-wide tripwire on the ground for 1 minute. Targets running over it are [stunned] for [scale:duration] second. Mounted enemies are dismounted and take [200%[ap]] [pd]. The tripwire is only visible within 3 meters.
[cd] 24 seconds.

modifications.effect: The tripwire [disarms] affected targets for 5 seconds.
Two tripwires can be placed at once.

rune-water-shield.name: Water Shield
rune-water-shield.descriptionEffect:
Launches a spherical water [shield] to the target area. Allies caught within the 2-meter impact radius gain a [shield] that absorbs [30 + [scale:heal]% [hasp]] [dmg].
[cd] 20 seconds.

modifications.effect: Reactivating the skill causes the [shield] to burst, dealing [100%[sp]] [md] to nearby enemies within a 3-meter radius.
Throwing the water sphere at an enemy lifts them into the air for 24 seconds for monsters and for 8 seconds for heroes. Any damage ends the effect.
